name: 5 Ingredient Cannellini Bean Curry
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the curry paste in a pot over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the coconut milk and cannellini beans and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Stir well to combine the curry.
Serve the curry spooned over the rice.

name: 5 Ingredient Lasagne
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the strained tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Layer the beef sauce, lasagne sheets, and white sauce in a small baking dish, repeating twice.
Top the final layer of white sauce with shredded cheddar.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

name: Aglio e Olio Spaghetti
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving half a cup of pasta water.
Meanwhile, warm the olive oil with the thinly sliced garlic over low heat until just golden.
Add the red pepper flakes and cook for 30 seconds.
Toss in the spaghetti with a splash of pasta water and swirl until glossy.
Stir through the chopped parsley.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and serve immediately.

name: Air Fried Popcorn Prawns with Burnt Chilli Mayo
instructions: Set the air fryer to 400°F.
Pat the shrimp dry, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Arrange the shrimp in a single layer in the air fryer basket and cook for 8 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, char the hot sauce in a dry skillet over high heat for 1 minute until it darkens slightly.
Stir the charred hot sauce into the mayonnaise to make the burnt chilli mayo.
Squeeze the lemon over the crispy shrimp.
Serve the popcorn shrimp with the burnt chilli mayo for dipping.

name: Air Fryer Beef Kofta Wraps
instructions: Grate a quarter of the red onion and squeeze out the liquid, then mix it into the beef with the cumin, chopped parsley and plenty of salt.
Shape the mixture into four long sausages, pressing firmly so they hold together.
Heat the air fryer to 400°F and cook the koftas for 12 minutes, turning them halfway, until browned and cooked through.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of water into a pourable sauce.
Slice the rest of the onion and the cucumber thinly.
Warm the wraps in the air fryer for 1 minute, then fill with koftas, salad and tahini sauce.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Kiev
instructions: Mash the softened butter with the minced garlic and chopped parsley, then chill for 10 minutes.
Cut a deep pocket into the side of the chicken breast and stuff with the garlic butter, pressing the edges to seal.
Set up three shallow bowls: flour, beaten egg, and panko breadcrumbs.
Coat the stuffed chicken in flour, then egg, then press firmly into the panko to fully coat.
Set the air fryer to 375°F and lightly spray the basket with oil.
Cook the chicken in the air fryer basket for 18 minutes, flipping halfway, until the coating is golden and the chicken reaches 165°F inside.
Rest for 3 minutes before slicing to let the butter settle.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Shawarma Wraps
instructions: Toss the chicken thighs with the cumin, smoked paprika, half the lemon juice, salt and a little oil.
Leave them to marinate while the air fryer heats to 400°F.
Cook the chicken for 16 minutes, turning once, until the edges char and the centre is no longer pink.
Whisk the tahini with the rest of the lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of water into a pourable sauce.
Slice the chicken into strips and shred the lettuce and onion.
Warm the wraps in the air fryer for 1 minute, then fill with chicken, salad and tahini and roll tightly.

name: Air Fryer Crispy Tofu Bowl
instructions: Press the tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes, then cut it into 1 inch cubes.
Toss the cubes with the soy sauce, leave for 2 minutes, then dust with the cornstarch until dry to the touch.
Heat the air fryer to 400°F and cook the tofu for 14 minutes, shaking the basket every 5 minutes, until deeply crisp.
Meanwhile simmer the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Add the edamame to the air fryer basket for the last 4 minutes so they warm through and blister.
Slice the cucumber into half moons and build the bowl with rice, tofu, edamame and cucumber, finished with sesame seeds.

name: Air Fryer Fish Tacos
instructions: Cut the cod into thick finger sized strips and season them with salt and the smoked paprika.
Dampen the strips with a little water and press them into the panko until well covered.
Heat the air fryer to 400°F and cook the fish for 10 minutes, turning once, until the crust is golden and crunchy.
Shred the cabbage finely and toss it with the juice of half the lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in the air fryer for 1 minute at the end so they soften.
Fill each tortilla with slaw, fish, sliced avocado and cilantro and squeeze the rest of the lime over.

name: Air Fryer Hunters Chicken
instructions: Set the air fryer to 375°F.
Season the chicken breast with smoked paprika and a pinch of salt.
Wrap the bacon strips around the chicken breast, overlapping slightly to cover it.
Cook the wrapped chicken in the air fryer basket for 16 minutes, turning once, until the bacon is crisp.
Brush the BBQ sauce generously over the top and scatter with cheddar.
Continue cooking in the air fryer basket for 4 minutes until the cheese melts and the chicken reaches 165°F inside.
Rest for 2 minutes before serving.

name: Air Fryer Pork Schnitzel
instructions: Put the pork loin between two sheets of parchment and beat it flat to about a quarter inch thick.
Season it well, then coat it in flour, beaten egg and panko in that order, pressing the crumbs on firmly.
Heat the air fryer to 400°F and cook the schnitzel for 12 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and cooked through.
Cut the baby potatoes into wedges and toss them with a little oil and salt.
Cook the wedges in the air fryer for 16 minutes alongside or straight after the pork, shaking the basket twice.
Serve with the parsley scattered over and the lemon cut into wedges for squeezing.

name: Anchovy Broccoli Spaghetti
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, adding the broccoli florets for the final 3 minutes, then drain, reserving 0.5 cup of the pasta water.
Mince the garlic and roughly chop the anchovy fillets.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and melt the anchovies with the garlic and red pepper flakes for 2 minutes, mashing with a spoon.
Add the drained spaghetti and broccoli to the skillet with a splash of the reserved pasta water.
Toss everything together over medium heat for 2 minutes until glossy.
Grate the parmesan over the top.
Serve immediately.

name: BBQ Chicken Loaded Wraps
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Toss the chicken with the BBQ sauce off the heat until fully coated.
Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds per side so they fold without cracking.
Shred the lettuce and thinly slice the red onion.
Fill each tortilla with the BBQ chicken, lettuce, red onion, and cheddar.
Add a dollop of sour cream, fold in the sides, and roll tightly to serve.

name: BBQ Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook the penne in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Dice the chicken and slice the red onion.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 6 minutes.
Add the onion and cook for 2 more minutes.
Stir in the BBQ sauce and strained tomatoes and simmer for 3 minutes.
Toss in the pasta, top with shredded cheddar, and let it melt before serving.

name: BBQ Jackfruit Burgers
instructions: Drain the jackfruit and pull it apart with two forks until it looks like shredded meat.
Fry it in a skillet with half the olive oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until the edges darken and dry out.
Stir in the smoked paprika and BBQ sauce with 2 tablespoons of water and simmer for 5 minutes until sticky.
Shred the cabbage and carrot and toss them with the vinegar, the rest of the oil and a pinch of salt.
Toast the cut sides of the bun in a dry pan for 1 minute until golden.
Pile the jackfruit into the bun and top generously with the slaw.

name: Bacon & Leek Carbonara
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in well salted water for 9 minutes, saving a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Beat the eggs with the grated parmesan and a lot of black pepper into a thick paste.
Fry the chopped bacon in a cold skillet brought up to medium heat for 6 minutes until the fat renders and the edges crisp.
Add the finely sliced leek and the minced garlic and cook for 5 minutes until soft and sweet.
Take the pan completely off the heat, add the drained pasta and a splash of the cooking water and toss.
Pour in the egg mixture and toss constantly for 1 minute, adding more water until the sauce turns silky rather than scrambled.

name: Bacon Cannellini Greens Stew
instructions: Dice the bacon and cook in a pot over medium heat for 5 minutes until crisp.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in the cannellini beans and vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing a few beans against the pot to thicken.
Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Season with black pepper and drizzle with olive oil before serving.

name: Baked Falafel Wraps
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Pulse the drained chickpeas, parsley, garlic and cumin in a food processor until the mix is coarse and holds together when squeezed.
Shape it into 8 small patties and press them flat so they cook through evenly.
Bake for 22 minutes, turning them once halfway, until firm and golden on both sides.
Whisk the tahini with 2 tablespoons of water and a pinch of salt into a loose sauce.
Warm the wraps in the oven for the last 2 minutes, then fill with falafel, sliced cucumber and red onion and drizzle with tahini.

name: Baked Mac & Cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Boil the macaroni in salted water for 7 minutes so it is still firm, then drain.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute until it smells nutty.
Pour in the milk a little at a time, whisking constantly, and simmer for 4 minutes until the sauce coats a spoon.
Take off the heat and stir in two thirds of the grated cheddar and the mustard until glossy.
Fold the pasta through the sauce, tip into a small baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese and the breadcrumbs.
Bake for 18 minutes until the top is crisp and the edges bubble.

name: Bean & Rice Burrito Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Warm the black beans and frozen corn together in a small pan over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Slice the avocado and roughly chop the cilantro.
Build the bowl with rice, the beans and corn, and salsa.
Top with sliced avocado and chopped cilantro.
Finish with a squeeze of lime juice.

name: Bean Chilli
instructions: Dice the onion and bell pepper and cook in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, chili powder, and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, kidney beans, and black beans.
Add a splash of water, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover and simmer for 5 more minutes to thicken.
Season to taste before serving.

name: Beef & Barley Soup
instructions: Cut the beef into small cubes, season them and brown them in a pot over high heat for 6 minutes.
Add the diced onion, carrot and celery and cook over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes until it darkens.
Pour in the broth with the rinsed barley, bring to a boil then drop to the lowest simmer.
Cover and cook for 35 minutes until the beef is tender and the barley has plumped up.
Stir the shredded kale through for the last 4 minutes and season generously.

name: Beef & Black Bean Rice
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Slice the steak thinly against the grain and toss it with the cornstarch.
Heat a wok until smoking and sear the beef in a single layer for 90 seconds per side, then lift it out.
Stir fry the sliced onion and pepper over high heat for 3 minutes so they stay crunchy.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger for 30 seconds, then the black bean sauce with 4 tablespoons of water.
Return the beef and toss for 1 minute until the sauce thickens, then serve over the rice.

name: Beef & Broccoli Noodles
instructions: Slice the steak thinly against the grain and toss it with the cornstarch and a teaspoon of the soy sauce.
Boil the egg noodles for 4 minutes, adding the broccoli for the last 2 minutes, then drain both.
Heat a wok until smoking, add the sesame oil and sear the beef in one layer for 90 seconds per side, then lift it out.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the wok and stir fry for 30 seconds.
Return the noodles, broccoli and beef with the rest of the soy sauce and 3 tablespoons of water.
Toss hard over high heat for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything.

name: Beef & Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Dice the onion and bell pepper, then brown with the ground beef in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the rice, diced tomatoes, and beef broth, and bring to a simmer.
Cover the skillet and transfer to the oven, baking for 30 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Remove from the oven and fluff the rice with a fork.
Scatter the cheddar over the top and return to the oven for 5 minutes until melted.
Rest for 3 minutes before serving.

name: Beef Burrito Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and lightly grease a small baking dish.
Dice the onion and brown it with the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the taco seasoning, black beans, and half the salsa, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds so they roll without cracking, then fill and roll them around the beef mixture.
Place the burritos seam-side down in the dish and spoon the remaining salsa over the top.
Scatter the cheddar over the burritos and bake for 15 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Rest for 3 minutes, then serve topped with sour cream.

name: Beef Chilli Rice Boxes
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Dice the onion and brown it with the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the kidney beans and diced tomatoes, and simmer for 12 minutes until thickened.
Spoon the rice into a bowl and top with the chilli.
Slice the avocado and fan it over the top before serving.

name: Beef Enchilada Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and lightly grease a small baking dish.
Dice the onion and brown it with the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Stir the chili powder and cumin into the strained tomatoes to make a quick enchilada sauce, then simmer for 2 minutes.
Spoon a little sauce and the beef into each tortilla, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the rolled tortillas and scatter the cheddar on top.
Bake for 15 minutes until the cheese is melted and the edges are bubbling.
Rest for 3 minutes and finish with chopped cilantro.

name: Beef Picadillo Rice
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a dry skillet over high heat for 7 minutes, pressing it flat so it crusts.
Add the diced onion and pepper and cook over medium heat for 7 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the crushed tomatoes, olives and raisins with a splash of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes.
Season the picadillo well and spoon it over the fluffed rice.

name: Beef Ragù Rigatoni
instructions: Dice the carrot, celery and onion very finely and sauté them in a heavy pot with a little oil over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Push them aside, raise the heat and brown the ground beef for 7 minutes without stirring too often.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes until it darkens to brick red.
Add the crushed tomatoes and 1 cup of water, bring to a boil then drop to the lowest simmer.
Cook uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Boil the rigatoni for 11 minutes, toss it through the ragù with a splash of pasta water and finish with grated parmesan.

name: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain.
Slice the steak into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a skillet over high heat and sear the steak for 2 minutes per side, then set aside.
Slice the onion and mushrooms and cook in the same skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes until softened.
Pour in the beef broth and Dijon mustard, scraping up the browned bits, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and return the steak to the skillet, warming through for 2 minutes without boiling.
Serve the stroganoff spooned over the egg noodles.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Dice the onion and brown it with the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water and simmer for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Shred the lettuce and dice the tomato.
Fill the tortillas with the beef, lettuce, and tomato.
Top with shredded cheddar and a dollop of sour cream.

name: Beef Teriyaki Noodles
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain.
Slice the steak into thin strips and mince the garlic.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and sear the steak for 3 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets, sliced carrot, and garlic and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Pour in the teriyaki sauce and toss to coat everything.
Add the noodles, toss for 1 minute, and top with sliced green onions.

name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Chilli
instructions: Sauté the diced onion in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and chipotle paste and cook for 1 minute until the kitchen smells smoky.
Add the peeled and cubed sweet potato, the crushed tomatoes and 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce to a simmer, cover and cook for 18 minutes until the sweet potato is tender but still holds its shape.
Add the drained black beans and the corn and simmer uncovered for 6 minutes so the chilli thickens.
Finish with the juice of the lime and season with salt.

name: Bombay Crusted Aubergine Nuggets with Tikka Chicken
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan.
Mix the yogurt with half the cumin and smoked paprika, then toss with the diced chicken thighs to marinate for 10 minutes.
Cut the eggplant into nugget-sized pieces, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in panko mixed with the remaining spices.
Spread the eggplant nuggets on the sheet pan and bake for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Meanwhile, thread the marinated chicken onto a skewer or leave loose and sear in a hot skillet for 8 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Rest the chicken for 2 minutes, then slice.
Serve the tikka chicken alongside the crispy aubergine nuggets.

name: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Fry the bacon in a skillet until crisp, then drain on paper towels.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan over low heat until just set.
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan for 20 seconds.
Layer the eggs, bacon, shredded cheddar, and sliced avocado down the center.
Add the hot sauce and sliced green onions.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly, and toast seam-side down for 1 minute.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
instructions: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat and sauté the diced onion and grated carrot for 6 minutes.
Sprinkle in the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly so it does not colour.
Whisk in the broth a little at a time, then the milk, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the broccoli florets and simmer for 10 minutes until they are soft enough to crush against the pan.
Blend about half the soup so it turns creamy but keeps some texture.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the grated cheddar until it melts, then season with salt and black pepper.

name: Brown Butter Tortelloni
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the tortelloni for 4 minutes until they float, then drain, reserving a splash of pasta water.
While the pasta cooks, mince the garlic and chop the parsley.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook for 3 minutes, swirling constantly, until it turns golden brown and smells nutty.
Add the garlic to the browned butter and sauté for 30 seconds.
Toss the drained tortelloni in the brown butter with a splash of pasta water to loosen the sauce.
Plate and finish with grated Parmesan, chopped parsley, and a crack of black pepper.

name: Buffalo Chicken Loaded Fries
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and bake the fries on a sheet pan for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp.
Meanwhile, dice the chicken breast and season with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce in the skillet and toss the chicken to coat.
Pile the crispy fries on a plate and scatter the cheddar over the top.
Return to the oven for 3 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with the buffalo chicken, a drizzle of sour cream, and sliced green onions.

name: Buffalo Chicken Salad Bowl
instructions: Butterfly the chicken breast and season it, then sear it in a hot skillet for 5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Melt the butter into the hot sauce in the same pan over low heat.
Shred the chicken with two forks and toss it through the buffalo sauce until fully coated.
Cut the celery and carrot into thin sticks and shred the romaine.
Thin the yogurt with a splash of water and a pinch of salt to make a cooling dressing.
Build the bowl with lettuce, black beans and vegetables, pile the buffalo chicken on top and drizzle with the yogurt.

name: Burrito Bowls
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Brown the ground beef in a hot skillet for 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Warm the black beans in the same pan.
Build the bowl with rice, beef, beans, and shredded lettuce.
Top with salsa, shredded cheddar, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Butter Bean Carbonara with Garlicky Asparagus
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti for 9 minutes until al dente; reserve 0.25 cup of pasta water and drain.
While the pasta cooks, whisk the egg with the grated Parmesan and a generous crack of black pepper in a bowl.
Trim the asparagus and cut into 2-inch pieces; mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute the asparagus and garlic for 4 minutes until bright green and tender.
Add the drained butter beans to the skillet and warm through for 2 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the heat, add the hot spaghetti, then pour in the egg mixture, tossing quickly with the reserved pasta water until glossy and creamy.
Serve immediately topped with extra black pepper and Parmesan.

name: Cacio e Pepe
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in generously salted boiling water for 1 minute less than the package says, reserving 1 cup of the pasta water before draining.
Toast the black pepper in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant.
Finely grate the parmesan and pecorino together.
Add the butter and a splash of the reserved pasta water to the skillet with the pepper and melt over low heat.
Add the drained spaghetti to the skillet and toss, then remove from the heat and add the grated cheese a handful at a time, tossing constantly.
Loosen with more pasta water as needed until glossy and creamy.
Serve immediately with extra black pepper on top.

name: Cajun Chicken Rice
instructions: Dice the chicken and coat it in the cajun seasoning.
Brown the chicken in olive oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the diced onion, bell pepper, and garlic in the same pan for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, then pour in the chicken broth.
Return the chicken, cover, and simmer on low for 15 minutes until the rice is tender.
Fluff with a fork and serve straight from the pan.

name: Cajun Red Bean Rice Bowl
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice, then simmer it in a saucepan with the vegetable broth for 15 minutes until tender; fluff with a fork.
While the rice cooks, dice the onion and bell pepper and mince the garlic.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute the onion and pepper for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic and Cajun seasoning and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the drained kidney beans and diced tomatoes, then simmer for 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt to taste and spoon the Cajun bean mixture over the rice to serve.

name: Cajun Salmon Rice
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Rub the salmon all over with the cajun seasoning.
Pan-fry the salmon in olive oil for 4 minutes per side, then flake into chunks.
Sauté the sliced bell pepper in the same pan for 3 minutes.
Stir the peppers through the rice and top with the flaked salmon.
Mix the greek yogurt with lime juice and drizzle over the bowl.
Scatter over the sliced green onions.

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil the penne in well salted water for 10 minutes until al dente, then drain and rinse briefly under cold water.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and toss them with a pinch of salt so they release their juice.
Whisk the olive oil, balsamic vinegar and grated garlic into a dressing and stir in the tomato juices.
Tear the mozzarella into rough pieces rather than cutting it neatly.
Toss the pasta, tomatoes and mozzarella through the dressing.
Tear the basil over at the very last moment and season with black pepper.

name: Cashew Honey Broccoli Noodles
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain and set aside.
Toast the cashews in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes until golden, then roughly chop.
Mince the garlic and cut the broccoli into small florets.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the broccoli for 4 minutes until just tender.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the honey and soy sauce and simmer for 1 minute.
Add the noodles and toss for 1 minute to coat.
Scatter with the toasted cashews to serve.

name: Chargrilled Pepper Pasta
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 10 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Quarter the bell peppers and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over high heat and char the peppers for 6 minutes, turning occasionally, until blistered.
Add the tomatoes and minced garlic and cook for 2 minutes until the tomatoes start to soften.
Transfer the peppers and tomatoes to a blender with a splash of pasta water and blitz into a chunky sauce.
Toss the sauce with the drained pasta, then plate and top with grated Parmesan and torn basil.

name: Charred Corn & Avocado Salad
instructions: Heat a dry skillet over high heat until it is almost smoking.
Tip in the corn in a single layer and leave it untouched for 3 minutes so it chars, then toss and cook 2 minutes more.
Finely dice the red onion and leave it to soak in the lime juice with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes.
Slice the avocado and shred the romaine into ribbons.
Toss the lettuce, corn, black beans and onion with the olive oil and the limey soaking juice.
Top with the avocado and chopped cilantro and season with flaky salt.

name: Cheddar & Red Onion Tartlets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Thinly slice the red onion and caramelize in a skillet with the olive oil over medium heat for 12 minutes.
Roll out the puff pastry and score a border 0.5 inch from the edge.
Brush the border with beaten egg and scatter the caramelized onion and shredded cheddar over the center.
Season with black pepper.
Bake for 20 minutes until the pastry is puffed and golden.

name: Cheesy Bean Quesadillas
instructions: Mash the black beans lightly with the cumin and finely diced red onion.
Spread the bean mixture over half of one tortilla and scatter with shredded cheddar.
Fold the tortilla over and repeat with the second tortilla.
Heat a dry skillet over medium heat and cook each quesadilla for 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Slice into wedges.
Serve with the salsa for dipping.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 9 minutes, adding the broccoli florets for the final 3 minutes, then drain both together.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat and whisk in the flour, cooking for 1 minute to form a paste.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer for 4 minutes, stirring often, until thickened.
Mince the garlic and stir it into the sauce along with the shredded cheddar until melted and smooth.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Toss the pasta and broccoli in the cheese sauce and serve immediately.

name: Cheesy Chicken Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and lightly grease a small baking dish.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper and place in the dish with the halved cherry tomatoes.
Mince the garlic and whisk it into the heavy cream with the parmesan.
Pour the cream mixture over the chicken and tomatoes.
Scatter the mozzarella over the top and bake for 35 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F inside and the top is golden.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Finish with torn fresh basil.

name: Cheesy Tomato Risotto
instructions: Soften the diced onion and garlic in butter over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and toast for 1 minute.
Add the strained tomatoes and a ladle of warm broth.
Keep adding broth a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed, for about 18 minutes.
Stir in the cheddar and parmesan until melted and creamy.
Rest for 2 minutes and serve topped with torn basil.

name: Chicken & Avocado Salad
instructions: Butterfly the chicken breast so it is an even thickness and season it well with salt and pepper.
Sear it in a hot skillet with the olive oil for 5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then slice it thickly across the grain.
Slice the red onion paper thin and soak it in the juice of one lime with a pinch of salt.
Shred the romaine and halve the tomatoes, then toss them with the limey onion.
Top with the sliced chicken, wedges of avocado and plenty of cilantro.

name: Chicken & Bacon Pasta
instructions: Cook the penne in salted boiling water according to the package, then drain, reserving a splash of the pasta water.
Dice the chicken and bacon and cook together in a skillet over medium-high heat for 7 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the bacon is crisp.
Mince the garlic and stir it into the skillet, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan until melted, then add the spinach and wilt for 1 minute.
Toss the drained penne through the sauce, loosening with the reserved pasta water if needed.
Serve immediately with extra parmesan on top.

name: Chicken & Broccoli Pasta
instructions: Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 9 minutes, adding the broccoli florets for the final 3 minutes, then drain, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Meanwhile, dice the chicken breast and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Mince the garlic and add it with the red pepper flakes, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Toss the drained pasta and broccoli into the skillet with the reserved pasta water to loosen.
Stir in the parmesan until it coats the pasta evenly.
Serve hot with extra parmesan on top.

name: Chicken & Chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the potatoes into thick chips, toss with half the olive oil, and spread on a sheet pan.
Roast the chips for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, rub the chicken breast with the remaining olive oil and smoked paprika.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes per side until it reaches 165°F inside.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then slice.
Serve the sliced chicken alongside the chips with ketchup on the side.

name: Chicken & Leek Pie
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Dice the chicken and carrot, and sauté in the butter in a saucepan over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then whisk in the chicken broth and heavy cream.
Simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through.
Pour the filling into a small pie dish.
Beat the egg and brush it over the pie edges for shine, then bake for 20 minutes until golden on top.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

name: Chicken & Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Keep the chicken broth at a bare simmer in a small saucepan.
Season the diced chicken and sear it in a wide pan with a little oil for 6 minutes until golden, then lift it out.
Fry the sliced mushrooms in the same pan over high heat for 6 minutes until browned, then set them aside too.
Lower the heat, sauté the diced onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and the rice and toast for 2 minutes.
Add the hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting for each addition to absorb, for about 18 minutes.
Return the chicken and mushrooms for the last 3 minutes, then beat in the parmesan and thyme off the heat.

name: Chicken & Sweet Corn Soup
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a simmer in a pot with the grated ginger.
Poach the whole chicken breast in the broth for 12 minutes, then lift it out and shred it finely.
Add the sweet corn and simmer for 3 minutes, crushing a few kernels against the side for body.
Mix the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of cold water and stir it in, simmering for 2 minutes until the soup thickens.
Turn the heat to low, return the chicken, then pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream while stirring in one direction.
Finish with the soy sauce and sesame oil off the heat.

name: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook the fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Slice the chicken and season with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in butter over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the minced garlic in the same pan for 30 seconds.
Pour in the cream, simmer for 2 minutes, and stir in the grated parmesan.
Toss the pasta and chicken in the sauce, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Finish with chopped parsley.

name: Chicken Broccoli Rice
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, dice the chicken breast and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Mince the garlic and add it to the skillet along with the broccoli florets, cooking for 4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Stir in the soy sauce and toss to coat.
Fold in the cooked rice and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve hot straight from the skillet.

name: Chicken Burrito Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F and lightly grease a small baking dish.
Dice the chicken breast and season with the taco seasoning.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the black beans, corn, and half the salsa, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken mixture, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in the dish.
Spoon the remaining salsa over the top and scatter with cheddar, then bake for 15 minutes until melted and golden.
Rest for 3 minutes before serving.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowls
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Dice the chicken and toss it with the taco seasoning.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet for 7 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the black beans and corn in the same pan for 2 minutes.
Build the bowl with rice, chicken, beans, and corn.
Top with salsa, sliced avocado, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Toss the panko breadcrumbs with the olive oil and spread on a tray; bake for 6 minutes until golden, then set aside as croutons.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then slice it into strips.
Chop the romaine lettuce and place it in a large bowl.
Toss the lettuce with the Caesar dressing and shaved Parmesan.
Top with the sliced chicken and toasted panko croutons before serving.

name: Chicken Caesar Wraps
instructions: Slice the chicken and season with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in olive oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until golden.
Chop the romaine and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Toss the lettuce and tomatoes with the caesar dressing and shaved parmesan.
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan for 20 seconds.
Pile in the salad and chicken, roll up tightly, and slice in half.

name: Chicken Curry Broth
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-size pieces and slice the carrot thinly; grate the ginger.
Heat a splash of oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the ginger and cumin for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken and sear for 3 minutes, turning, until lightly browned.
Pour in the chicken broth and carrot, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes until the broth is creamy.
Season with salt to taste.
Ladle into a bowl and top with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Chicken Curry Rice Boxes
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, dice the chicken breast, onion, and carrot.
Sear the chicken and onion in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until the chicken is lightly browned.
Stir in the curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and add the carrot, then simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through.
Spoon the rice into a bowl and top with the curry.
Finish with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Chicken Enchilada Bowls
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, dice the chicken breast and season with the chili powder.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the black beans and strained tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Spoon the rice into a bowl and top with the chicken mixture.
Scatter the cheddar over the hot chicken so it melts slightly.
Slice the avocado and fan it over the top before serving.

name: Chicken Fajita Bowls
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Slice the chicken, bell pepper, and red onion into strips.
Toss the chicken and vegetables with the olive oil and taco seasoning.
Sear everything in a hot skillet for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the peppers are charred.
Serve over the rice with a squeeze of lime.
Finish with a dollop of sour cream.

name: Chicken Fajita Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Slice the chicken, pepper and onion into thick strips and toss them with the cumin, paprika and salt.
Heat a skillet until very hot and sear the chicken in one layer for 4 minutes without moving it.
Add the pepper and onion and cook for 6 more minutes until everything is charred at the edges.
Stir the drained black beans through for the last 2 minutes to warm them.
Fluff the rice with the juice of one lime and pile the fajita mix on top.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain and spread on a plate to cool slightly.
Dice the chicken breast and carrot.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through, then push to one side.
Beat the egg and scramble it in the empty side of the skillet for 1 minute, breaking it into small pieces.
Add the carrot and peas and stir-fry for 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add the cooled rice and soy sauce, tossing everything together for 3 minutes over high heat.
Finish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.

name: Chicken Gyros Wraps
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and squeeze half the lemon juice over it.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
Whisk the Greek yogurt with the remaining lemon juice and a pinch of salt to make a quick sauce.
Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds per side so they fold without cracking.
Dice the tomato and thinly slice the red onion.
Fill each tortilla with the chicken, tomato, red onion, and crumbled feta.
Drizzle with the yogurt sauce, fold, and roll tightly to serve.

name: Chicken Lime Noodle Soup
instructions: Slice the chicken breast thinly and grate the ginger.
Bring the chicken broth to a simmer in a pot over medium heat and add the ginger.
Add the sliced chicken and simmer for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Add the egg noodles to the pot and cook for 3 minutes until tender.
Squeeze in the juice of the lime and stir through.
Season with salt to taste.
Ladle into a bowl and top with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Chicken Meatball Pasta
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Ground the chicken breast in a food processor, then mix with the beaten egg and panko breadcrumbs.
Roll the mixture into 6 meatballs and pan-fry in a skillet over medium heat for 8 minutes, turning until browned all over.
Pour in the marinara sauce and simmer for 6 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce and meatballs.
Top with grated Parmesan and torn basil before serving.

name: Chicken Nachos
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Dice the chicken breast and season with salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Spread the tortilla chips on a sheet pan and scatter the chicken and black beans over the top.
Cover generously with the cheddar and bake for 8 minutes until the cheese is fully melted.
Drizzle with the salsa and sour cream.
Finish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately while hot.

name: Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
instructions: Boil the egg noodles for 4 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water so they do not stick.
Slice the chicken into thin strips and season with salt.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and stir fry the chicken for 5 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the sliced pepper and sugar snap peas and stir fry for 3 minutes so they stay bright and crunchy.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Tip in the noodles and soy sauce with 2 tablespoons of water and toss hard for 2 minutes.

name: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Butterfly the chicken breast and pound it to an even thickness.
Dip the chicken in beaten egg, then coat it in the panko mixed with grated parmesan.
Pan-fry the chicken in olive oil for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Transfer to a baking dish, spoon over the marinara, and top with mozzarella.
Bake for 12 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and the chicken is cooked through.

name: Chicken Pasta Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and lightly grease a small baking dish.
Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 8 minutes until just shy of tender, then drain.
Dice the chicken breast and sear in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Stir the marinara sauce into the skillet with the chicken and simmer for 2 minutes.
Toss the drained penne through the sauce, then transfer everything to the baking dish.
Scatter the mozzarella and parmesan over the top and bake for 15 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest for 3 minutes and finish with torn basil.

name: Chicken Peanut Crunch Noodles
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain and set aside.
Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and julienne the carrot.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the carrot and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of hot water until smooth.
Add the noodles and peanut sauce to the wok, tossing for 2 minutes until everything is well coated.
Top with sliced green onions before serving.

name: Chicken Philly Cheesesteak Wraps
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and thinly slice the bell pepper and onion.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the pepper and onion and cook for 5 minutes more until softened and the chicken is cooked through.
Scatter the mozzarella over the chicken mixture, cover, and let it melt for 2 minutes off the heat.
Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds per side so they fold without cracking.
Fill each tortilla with the cheesy chicken and pepper mixture.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly to serve.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and dice the bell pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through; remove and set aside.
Add the bell pepper to the same skillet and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Lay one tortilla in the skillet, scatter over half the cheddar, then the chicken, peppers, and remaining cheddar, and top with the second tortilla.
Cook for 2 minutes per side over medium heat, pressing gently, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Slice into wedges.
Serve with the salsa on the side.

name: Chicken Ramen Bowl
instructions: Bring a small pot of water to a boil and cook the egg for 7 minutes for a soft-boiled center, then cool, peel, and halve.
Slice the chicken breast thinly and cook in a splash of oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through.
In a separate pot, bring the chicken broth and soy sauce to a simmer.
Add the egg noodles to the broth and cook for 3 minutes until tender.
Ladle the noodles and broth into a bowl.
Top with the sliced chicken and halved soft-boiled egg.
Scatter sliced green onions over the top before serving.

name: Chicken Rice Casserole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Dice the chicken breast and carrot, then brown the chicken in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the carrot and rice, stirring to coat, then pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Cover the skillet and transfer to the oven, baking for 25 minutes until the rice is tender.
Stir in the peas and let them warm through for 2 minutes.
Scatter the cheddar over the top and return to the oven for 5 minutes until melted.
Rest for 3 minutes before serving.

name: Chicken Rogan Josh Curry
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Dice the chicken thighs and finely chop the onion, garlic, and ginger.
Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger in a skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and sear for 4 minutes, stirring to coat in the spices.
Pour in the diced tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickens.
Serve the curry spooned over the rice.

name: Chicken Satay Noodle Bowls
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain.
Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and julienne the carrot.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the coconut milk and soy sauce and simmer for 4 minutes until slightly thickened into a satay-style sauce.
Add the carrot and cook for 2 minutes until just tender.
Toss the noodles through the sauce until well coated.
Spoon into a bowl and top with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Satay Salad
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Whisk the peanut butter with the lime juice and 2 tablespoons of warm water until smooth to make the satay dressing.
Shred the romaine lettuce, carrot, and red cabbage into a large bowl.
Top the salad with the cooked chicken.
Drizzle over the peanut satay dressing.
Finish with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Chicken Shawarma Flatbreads
instructions: Slice the chicken thighs into strips and toss with the cumin, smoked paprika, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Sear the chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
Thinly shred the red cabbage and toss with the remaining lemon juice.
Whisk the Greek yogurt with a pinch of salt to make a quick sauce.
Warm the flatbreads for 20 seconds per side so they fold without cracking.
Fill each flatbread with the chicken and shredded cabbage.
Drizzle with the yogurt sauce, fold, and roll tightly to serve.

name: Chicken Shawarma Salad
instructions: Slice the chicken thighs into strips and toss with the smoked paprika, cumin, and a pinch of salt.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 7 minutes, turning, until deeply browned and cooked through.
Squeeze half the lemon juice over the chicken and toss to coat.
Chop the romaine lettuce and halve the cherry tomatoes in a large bowl.
Whisk the Greek yogurt with the remaining lemon juice and a pinch of salt to make the dressing.
Top the salad with the warm shawarma chicken.
Drizzle with the yogurt dressing before serving.

name: Chicken Souvlaki Rice
instructions: Cube the chicken breast and toss with olive oil, minced garlic, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and let marinate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse the basmati rice, then simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Heat a griddle pan over medium-high heat and cook the skewers for 8-9 minutes, turning often, until charred and cooked through to 165°F internally.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion.
Stir the remaining lemon juice into the greek yogurt to make a quick sauce.
Serve the rice topped with the souvlaki chicken, tomatoes, onion, and a drizzle of the yogurt sauce.

name: Chicken Taco Salad
instructions: Dice the chicken and toss it with the taco seasoning.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet for 7 minutes, adding the corn for the last 2 minutes.
Chop the romaine and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Rinse and drain the black beans.
Toss the lettuce, tomatoes, beans, chicken, and corn in a large bowl with lime juice.
Top with shredded cheddar and crushed tortilla chips.

name: Chicken Tacos
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and toss with the taco seasoning.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 7-8 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Dice the tomato and shred the lettuce while the chicken cooks.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with the seasoned chicken.
Top with tomato, lettuce, shredded cheddar, and a spoon of sour cream.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the tacos before serving.

name: Chicken Tenders with Chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and spread the frozen fries on a baking tray.
Bake the fries for 18-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Slice the chicken breast into strips and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Set up a dredging station: flour in one bowl, beaten egg in another, and panko in a third.
Coat each chicken strip in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing to adhere.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry the tenders for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through to 165°F.
Drain the tenders on paper towel and serve alongside the fries with ketchup.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala Rice
instructions: Cube the chicken breast and toss with the greek yogurt, minced garlic, grated ginger, cumin, and paprika; marinate for 10 minutes.
Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the marinated chicken for 6-7 minutes until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes, breaking them down slightly.
Lower the heat and stir in the heavy cream, simmering for 3 more minutes until thickened.
Season the tikka masala with salt to taste.
Serve the chicken tikka masala spooned over the basmati rice.

name: Chicken Veg Noodles
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain.
Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and mince the garlic.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5-6 minutes until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Add the broccoli florets, sliced carrot, and bell pepper and stir-fry for 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, tossing everything together for 2 minutes until well coated.

name: Chilli Cheese Beef Pasta
instructions: Cook the penne in boiling salted water for 10-11 minutes until al dente, then drain, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic while the pasta cooks.
Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic to the beef and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and chili powder and simmer for 6 minutes until slightly thickened.
Toss the drained penne into the beef sauce with a splash of pasta water to loosen it.
Remove from the heat and stir in half the cheddar until melted, then top with the remaining cheese to serve.

name: Chipotle Chicken Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Season the chicken breast with the chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through to 165°F.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then slice it into strips.
Warm the black beans and frozen corn together in the same skillet for 3 minutes.
Stir the beans and corn through the cooked rice.
Top the rice with the sliced chicken, a squeeze of lime, and chopped cilantro.

name: Chipotle Lentil Tacos
instructions: Simmer the rinsed lentils in a pot of water for 20 minutes until tender, then drain.
Sauté the diced onion in a skillet with a splash of oil over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the chipotle and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes until the mix turns brick red.
Add the lentils and 3 tablespoons of water and cook for 4 minutes, mashing lightly so the filling holds together.
Shred the cabbage and toss it with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side and fill with the lentils, slaw and cilantro.

name: Chorizo & Chickpea Stew
instructions: Fry the diced chorizo in a dry pot over medium heat for 5 minutes until the red oil runs out of it.
Add the diced onion and pepper and cook for 7 minutes in the chorizo fat until soft.
Stir in the sliced garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes with half a cup of water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas and simmer for 5 more minutes so the stew thickens around them.
Fold the spinach through until wilted and check the seasoning before serving.

name: Chorizo Butter Bean Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Slice the chorizo and cook in an oven-safe pot over medium heat for 4 minutes until the oil releases.
Add the diced onion and garlic and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in the smoked paprika, diced tomatoes, and butter beans.
Simmer for 3 minutes, then transfer the pot to the oven.
Bake uncovered for 20 minutes until bubbling and slightly thickened.

name: Chorizo Butter Bean Baked Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Pierce the potato several times with a fork and bake directly on the rack for 55 minutes until tender.
About 15 minutes before the potato is ready, dice the chorizo and red onion.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and fry the chorizo for 4 minutes until it releases its oil and turns crisp.
Add the red onion and smoked paprika and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in the drained butter beans and simmer for 4 minutes until warmed through.
Split the baked potato open, fluff the flesh with a fork, and pile the chorizo and butter bean mixture on top.
Finish with a dollop of sour cream and sliced green onions.

name: Clam & Tomato Spaghetti
instructions: Scrub the clams under cold water and discard any that stay open when tapped.
Boil the spaghetti in well salted water for 9 minutes, saving a cup of the cooking water.
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan and cook the sliced garlic and chili flakes over medium heat for 90 seconds.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes until they slump and release their juice.
Tip in the clams with a splash of the pasta water, cover and steam for 4 minutes until they open, discarding any that do not.
Add the drained spaghetti and toss for 1 minute, then finish with the chopped parsley.

name: Classic Beef Chilli
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a dry pot over high heat for 7 minutes, pressing it flat so it crusts rather than steams.
Add the diced onion and pepper and cook for 7 minutes over medium heat.
Stir in the cumin and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute until the spices smell toasted.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes with half a cup of water and simmer gently for 20 minutes.
Add the drained kidney beans and simmer for 8 more minutes until the chilli is thick enough to hold a spoon.
Boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes, drain, and serve the chilli over it.

name: Classic Fishcakes
instructions: Boil the potato in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain and mash.
Poach the fish fillet in gently simmering water for 8 minutes, then drain and flake.
Mix the mashed potato, flaked fish, chopped parsley, and lemon zest in a bowl.
Shape the mixture into 2 patties, then dip each in beaten egg and coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry the fishcakes for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.

name: Coconut Chickpea Curry Noodles
instructions: Sauté the sliced onion in a wide pan with a splash of oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute until the pan smells warm and toasty.
Pour in the coconut milk and half a cup of water and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the drained chickpeas and simmer for 6 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly.
Drop in the rice noodles and cook for 4 minutes, stirring so they separate in the sauce.
Stir the spinach through until wilted and finish with a squeeze of lime.

name: Coconut Red Lentil Dal
instructions: Sauté the diced onion in a saucepan with a splash of oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft and translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic, grated ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the rinsed lentils, the coconut milk and 1 cup of water, bring to a boil then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 18 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the lentils collapse into a thick dal.
Meanwhile cook the basmati rice in a separate pot of boiling salted water for 10 minutes and drain.
Stir the spinach through the dal until wilted, season with salt and serve over the rice.

name: Cod & Chickpea Stew
instructions: Sauté the diced onion in a wide pan with the olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the sliced garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring so the paprika does not burn.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes with half a cup of water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and simmer for 5 more minutes until the sauce thickens.
Season the cod, lay it on top of the stew, cover the pan and poach gently for 8 minutes until it flakes.
Fold the spinach into the sauce around the fish and season with salt before serving.

name: Cornflake Crusted Chicken Salad
instructions: Crush the cornflakes into coarse crumbs in a bowl.
Slice the chicken breast into strips, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat in the crushed cornflakes.
Pan-fry the chicken in a little oil over medium heat for 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Chop the romaine lettuce and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Toss the lettuce and tomatoes with the Caesar dressing in a large bowl.
Slice the crispy chicken and place on top of the salad.
Finish with shaved cheddar cheese.

name: Cottage Pie
instructions: Peel and chop the potatoes, then boil in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, dice the onion and carrot and brown the ground beef with them in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk until smooth.
Spoon the beef mixture into an oven-safe dish and spread the mashed potato on top.
Rough up the surface with a fork and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Creamy Cauliflower Cashew Mac Bake
instructions: Soak the cashews in hot water for 10 minutes to soften, then drain.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni for 8 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Steam the cauliflower florets for 6 minutes until tender.
Blend the soaked cashews, cauliflower, vegetable broth, and garlic until smooth and creamy.
Stir the cashew-cauliflower sauce and shredded cheddar into the macaroni, then transfer to an oven-safe dish and top with panko.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes until the top is golden and crisp.

name: Creamy Cheddar Garlic Bread Pasta Bake
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 9 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Mince the garlic and melt the butter with half of it in a saucepan over medium heat for 1 minute.
Whisk in the heavy cream and simmer for 3 minutes, then stir in the shredded cheddar until melted into a smooth sauce.
Toss the pasta in the cheese sauce and transfer to an oven-safe dish.
Slice the baguette, rub with the remaining garlic, and tuck the slices around the pasta.
Bake at 400°F for 12 minutes until the bread is toasted and the top is bubbling, then sprinkle with parsley.

name: Creamy Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook the fettuccine in boiling salted water for 10-11 minutes until al dente, then drain, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Slice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and mince the garlic.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan until melted and the sauce thickens slightly.
Toss in the drained fettuccine with a splash of pasta water and finish with chopped parsley.

name: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pasta
instructions: Cook the penne in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Melt the butter and cook the minced garlic gently for 1 minute.
Pour in the cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Stir in the grated parmesan until the sauce is smooth.
Fold in the spinach until wilted.
Toss in the pasta, loosen with pasta water, and finish with black pepper.

name: Creamy Mushroom & Spinach Polenta
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a saucepan, then whisk in the polenta in a steady stream.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Meanwhile, slice the mushrooms and mince the garlic.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the mushrooms with the garlic for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the spinach to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Stir the Parmesan into the polenta, spoon into a bowl, and top with the mushrooms and spinach.

name: Creamy Nando's Rice Bowls
instructions: Rinse the rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then fluff and set aside.
Mince the garlic and rub the chicken thighs with half of it, the smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet for 5 minutes per side until cooked through and lightly charred.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then slice into strips.
Whisk the Greek yogurt with the remaining garlic, a squeeze of lemon, and the red pepper flakes to make the sauce.
Spoon the rice into a bowl, top with the sliced chicken, and drizzle generously with the creamy sauce.

name: Creamy Tomato Butter Bean Stew
instructions: Sauté the diced onion in a wide pan with a splash of oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until sweet and golden at the edges.
Add the sliced garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly so the paprika does not catch.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce darkens and thickens.
Stir in the drained butter beans and the coconut milk and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Fold the spinach through until just wilted and season with salt and black pepper.
Toast the sourdough in a dry skillet for 2 minutes per side and serve alongside for dipping.

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through to 165°F; set aside.
Mince the garlic and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Add the garlic to the same skillet and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer for 2 minutes, scraping up any browned bits.
Stir in the parmesan, spinach, and cherry tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top to serve.

name: Crispy Chicken Salad
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into strips and season with salt and pepper.
Set up a breading station: flour in one bowl, beaten egg in a second, and panko breadcrumbs in a third.
Coat each chicken strip in flour, then egg, then press into the panko to coat evenly.
Heat a shallow layer of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry the chicken strips for 4 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Drain the crispy chicken on paper towel.
Chop the romaine lettuce and halve the cherry tomatoes into a large bowl, then toss with the mayonnaise.
Top the salad with the crispy chicken strips before serving.

name: Crispy Chicken and Carrot Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F and set a wire rack over a sheet pan.
Grate the carrot and rinse the rice, then simmer the rice with the grated carrot and chicken broth for 12 minutes until tender.
Pound the chicken thighs to an even thickness, then dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in panko.
Pan-fry the chicken in a hot skillet with a little oil for 3 minutes per side until golden, then transfer to the rack.
Bake the chicken for 10 minutes until cooked through and crisp.
Slice the chicken and serve over the carrot rice.
Scatter with sliced green onions to finish.

name: Crispy Chickpea Caesar Salad
instructions: Drain the chickpeas and dry them thoroughly on a towel so they crisp rather than steam.
Fry them in a skillet with the olive oil over medium-high heat for 9 minutes, shaking often, until the skins split and rattle.
Tear the sourdough into rough croutons, add them to the pan for the last 4 minutes and toss until golden.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, grated garlic, nutritional yeast, a pinch of salt and 3 tablespoons of water into a pourable dressing.
Chop the romaine into thick ribbons and toss it through the dressing until every leaf is coated.
Top with the warm chickpeas and croutons and finish with black pepper.

name: Crispy Chilli Tofu Bowl
instructions: Simmer the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat for 5 minutes.
Press the tofu between paper towels for 5 minutes, cut into 1 inch cubes and toss with the cornstarch until evenly coated.
Heat the sesame oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 8 minutes, turning every 2 minutes, until each side is golden and crisp.
Add the broccoli florets and 2 tablespoons of water to the pan, cover and steam for 3 minutes until bright green and just tender.
Stir the soy sauce and sriracha together, pour into the hot pan and toss for 1 minute until the glaze clings to the tofu.
Spoon over the rice and scatter with the sliced spring onion.

name: Crispy Fish Wraps
instructions: Cut the fish into thick strips, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry the fish in a little oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Thinly shred the red cabbage and toss with the mayonnaise and a squeeze of lime to make a quick slaw.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Lay the crispy fish strips down the center of each tortilla.
Top with the slaw.
Roll up the tortillas tightly to serve.

name: Crispy Gnocchi with Pesto
instructions: Toast the pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes until golden, then set them aside.
Add the olive oil to the same pan over medium-high heat and tip in the gnocchi straight from the packet.
Fry the gnocchi for 8 minutes without stirring too often, so each piece blisters and crisps on the outside.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and sliced garlic and cook for 3 minutes until the tomatoes burst.
Stir through the spinach until wilted, then take the pan off the heat and fold in the pesto.
Scatter the pine nuts over and season with black pepper.

name: Crispy Salmon Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Pat the salmon dry, season with salt and sear it skin side down in a hot skillet for 5 minutes until the skin lifts away cleanly.
Turn it over and cook for 2 more minutes, then flake it into large chunks in the pan.
Press the flakes flat against the hot pan for 2 minutes so the edges crisp up.
Stir the mayonnaise with the sriracha and soy sauce into a spooning sauce.
Pile the salmon on the rice with sliced avocado and cucumber, drizzle the sauce over and finish with sesame seeds.

name: Crispy Salmon Rice Salad
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Pat the salmon fillet dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the salmon skin-side down for 5 minutes until crisp.
Flip and cook for another 3 minutes until just cooked through, then flake into large chunks.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, slice the cucumber, and roughly chop the baby spinach.
Toss the rice with the spinach, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes in a bowl.
Top with the crispy salmon, a squeeze of lime juice, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

name: Crispy Sweet Chilli Beef Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Slice the sirloin steak into thin strips and toss in the flour to coat lightly.
Heat a generous splash of oil in a skillet over high heat and fry the beef strips for 3-4 minutes, turning, until crispy and cooked through.
Drain the beef on paper towel and wipe out the skillet.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, and red pepper flakes in the skillet and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly sticky.
Toss the crispy beef through the sauce to coat.
Serve the beef over the rice, sprinkled with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

name: Curried Butter Bean & Spinach Pot
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Dice the onion and cook in a pot over medium heat for 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in the minced garlic, grated ginger, and curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the butter beans and coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Serve the curried beans spooned over the rice.

name: Curried Cauliflower & Lentil Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the cauliflower florets with the olive oil and half the curry powder and roast for 25 minutes until charred at the tips.
Meanwhile sauté the diced onion in a pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, then add the rest of the curry powder.
Add the rinsed lentils, the coconut milk and 1 cup of water and simmer for 18 minutes until thick.
Stir the spinach through the lentils until wilted and season with salt.
Fold the roasted cauliflower into the lentils and scatter with cilantro.

name: Edamame Noodle Bowls
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes, adding the frozen edamame for the final 2 minutes; drain together.
Peel the carrot into thin ribbons and mince the garlic.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over medium-high heat and stir-fry the garlic and carrot ribbons for 2 minutes.
Add the drained noodles and edamame to the wok along with the soy sauce, tossing for 2 minutes until coated.
Divide between bowls and top with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, drain, and spread out to cool.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok and scramble the eggs, then set aside.
Stir-fry the diced carrot and minced garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and peas and toss over high heat for 3 minutes.
Return the eggs and pour in the soy sauce, tossing for 1 minute.
Serve topped with sliced green onions.

name: Egg Fried Rice with Peas
instructions: Cook the rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then spread it out to cool and dry.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and scramble the eggs for 40 seconds until just set, then tip them out.
Add the minced garlic and the frozen peas to the wok and stir fry for 2 minutes.
Tip in the cooled rice, press it flat for 1 minute to crisp, then toss for 2 minutes.
Return the egg, add the soy sauce and the sliced spring onion and toss for a final minute.

name: Falafel Rice Bowls
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 15 minutes, then fluff and set aside.
Pulse the chickpeas, garlic, cilantro, and ground cumin in a food processor until coarsely chunky.
Shape the mixture into 5-6 small patties.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry the falafel patties for 4 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the falafel.
Spoon the rice into a bowl and top with the falafel patties.

name: Fish & Chips
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the potatoes into thick chips, toss with olive oil, and roast on a tray for 30 minutes, turning halfway.
Dust the fish fillet in flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry the fish for 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Drain the fish briefly on paper towel.
Serve the fish alongside the chips with a wedge of lemon.

name: Fish Finger Wraps
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the fish into finger-sized strips, dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Arrange the fish fingers on a lined sheet pan and bake for 15 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Meanwhile, shred the romaine lettuce.
Mix the ketchup and mayonnaise together for a quick dipping sauce.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with lettuce and fish fingers, drizzle with the sauce, and roll up tightly.

name: Fish Taco Bowls
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Dust the fish with the taco seasoning.
Pan-fry the fish for 3 minutes per side, then flake into chunks.
Toss the shredded cabbage with half the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Mix the greek yogurt with the remaining lime juice to make a crema.
Build the bowl with rice, cabbage, and fish.
Top with sliced avocado, cilantro, and the lime crema.

name: Garlic Butter Chicken Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper and mince the garlic.
Melt half the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through to 165°F; set aside.
Add the remaining butter and garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it.
Pour in the chicken broth and simmer for 2 minutes, scraping up any browned bits.
Slice the chicken and return it to the skillet, tossing to coat in the garlic butter sauce.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the rice, finished with chopped parsley.

name: Garlic Butter Cod Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then fluff with a fork.
Steam the broccoli florets over the rice pot for the final 5 minutes until bright green and tender.
Pat the cod dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat, add the minced garlic, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Lay the cod in the skillet and cook for 4 minutes per side, basting with the garlic butter, until it flakes easily.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the cod and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the cod over the rice and broccoli, spooning any extra garlic butter on top.

name: Garlic Butter Salmon
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Pat the salmon dry and season with salt and pepper.
Sear the salmon skin-side down in a hot pan for 4 minutes.
Flip, add the butter and minced garlic, and baste for 3 minutes.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes until just tender.
Plate the salmon over the rice with the broccoli.
Spoon over the garlic butter, squeeze over the lemon, and finish with parsley.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Noodles
