instructions: Boil the egg noodles for 4 minutes, adding the broccoli florets for the last 2 minutes, then drain both.
Pat the shrimp dry and season them with salt.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the sliced garlic and chili flakes for 90 seconds.
Raise the heat and sear the shrimp for 90 seconds per side until pink and just firm.
Add the noodles, broccoli and soy sauce and toss hard for 1 minute so the butter coats everything.
Finish with the sliced spring onion and plenty of black pepper.

name: Garlic Butter Steak Rice
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Cut the steak into bite-size cubes and pat them dry.
Sear the steak in olive oil over high heat for 3 minutes until browned.
Add the butter and minced garlic and baste the steak for 1 minute.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes until just tender.
Serve the steak over the rice with the broccoli alongside.
Spoon over the garlic butter and finish with chopped parsley.

name: Garlic Chicken Noodles
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain.
Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and mince the garlic.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5-6 minutes until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Add the garlic and julienned carrot and stir-fry for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, tossing everything together for 2 minutes until well coated.
Top with sliced green onions before serving.

name: Garlic Chilli Chicken Noodles
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain and set aside.
Slice the chicken into thin strips, mince the garlic, and thinly slice the bell pepper.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and sear the chicken for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic, red pepper flakes, and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce with a splash of water and toss to coat, simmering for 1 minute.
Add the noodles and toss for 1 minute to combine.
Scatter with sliced green onions to serve.

name: Garlic Lime Chicken
instructions: Peel and cube the sweet potato, then boil in salted water for 12-14 minutes until fork-tender; drain.
Mince the garlic and juice the lime, mixing them with the olive oil to make a marinade.
Toss the chicken breast in the garlic-lime marinade and let sit for 10 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through to 165°F.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then slice it into strips.
Roughly mash the sweet potato with a fork and season with salt.
Serve the chicken over the mashed sweet potato, topped with chopped cilantro.

name: Garlic Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Warm the vegetable broth in a small saucepan and keep it at a bare simmer.
Fry the sliced mushrooms in half the olive oil over high heat for 6 minutes until browned, then lift them out.
Lower the heat, add the rest of the oil and sauté the diced onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the minced garlic and the rice and toast for 2 minutes until the grains look translucent at the edges.
Add the hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each addition is absorbed, for about 18 minutes.
Fold the mushrooms, thyme and nutritional yeast back in and season well before serving.

name: Garlic Prawn Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, drain, and spread out to cool slightly.
Sear the shrimp with the minced garlic in sesame oil for 2 minutes per side, then set aside.
Scramble the egg in the same wok, breaking it into pieces.
Add the rice and peas and stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes.
Return the shrimp and pour in the soy sauce, tossing for 1 minute.
Serve topped with sliced green onions.

name: Gochujang Cauliflower Bowl
instructions: Toss the cauliflower florets with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt until lightly dusted all over.
Heat the air fryer to 400°F and cook the cauliflower for 16 minutes, shaking the basket twice, until the edges are dark and crisp.
Meanwhile simmer the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Stir the gochujang with the sesame oil and 2 tablespoons of warm water into a glossy sauce.
Toss the hot cauliflower through the sauce so every floret is coated.
Serve on the rice with sliced cucumber and spring onion.

name: Greek Chicken Gyros Bowls
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion while the chicken cooks.
Mix the greek yogurt with lemon juice and minced garlic to make a tzatziki-style sauce.
Build the bowls with rice on the bottom, topped with the chicken, tomatoes, and onion.
Finish with crumbled feta and a drizzle of the yogurt sauce.

name: Greek Chicken Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through to 165°F.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then slice it into strips.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and squeeze the lemon juice over the rice.
Toss the rice with the tomatoes.
Top the rice with the sliced chicken and crumbled feta to serve.

name: Greek Chicken Salad
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Rest for 3 minutes, then slice into strips.
Chop the romaine lettuce, halve the cherry tomatoes, and thinly slice the red onion into a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt to make the dressing.
Toss the salad with the dressing and crumbled feta.
Top with the sliced chicken before serving.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Bowl
instructions: Cut the chicken into chunks and toss them with the oregano, half the lemon juice, one minced garlic clove, salt and a little oil.
Cover the couscous with an equal volume of boiling water and leave it covered for 6 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet for 4 minutes per side until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Grate a third of the cucumber, squeeze it dry and stir it into the yogurt with the remaining garlic and lemon.
Dice the rest of the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Build the bowl with couscous, chicken and salad and spoon the yogurt sauce over.

name: Greek Salad with Feta & Farro
instructions: Simmer the farro in a pot of salted water for 22 minutes until chewy but tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, cut the cucumber into thick half moons and slice the red onion paper thin.
Whisk the olive oil with the oregano, a splash of the olive brine and plenty of black pepper.
Toss the warm farro through the dressing so it soaks up the flavour.
Fold in the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and olives.
Crumble the feta over the top and serve while the grains are still a little warm.

name: Greek Style Butter Bean Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Sauté the diced onion and pepper in an ovenproof pan with the olive oil over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add the sliced garlic and cook for 1 minute, then pour in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the drained butter beans and half the dill and season firmly with salt.
Bake uncovered for 25 minutes until the top darkens and the sauce reduces around the edges.
Finish with the remaining dill, a squeeze of lemon and a last drizzle of olive oil.

name: Haddock & Pea Fishcakes
instructions: Boil the peeled and chunked potato in salted water for 16 minutes until tender, then drain and mash it dry.
Poach the haddock in a shallow pan of barely simmering water for 6 minutes, then lift it out and flake it, discarding the skin.
Cover the peas with boiling water for 3 minutes, drain and crush them roughly with a fork.
Fold the fish, peas, sliced spring onion, dill and lemon zest through the mash and season well.
Shape into four thick cakes, dip each in beaten egg and press into the panko.
Fry them in a skillet with a little oil over medium heat for 4 minutes per side until deep golden and hot through.

name: Halloumi & Chickpea Traybake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the pepper and zucchini into thick chunks and spread them on a baking sheet with the drained chickpeas.
Toss with the olive oil, oregano and a good pinch of salt and roast for 18 minutes.
Cut the halloumi into thick slices and add it to the tray with the cherry tomatoes.
Roast for 12 more minutes until the halloumi is golden and the tomatoes have split.
Squeeze the lemon over the hot tray and serve straight from it.

name: Halloumi & Couscous Salad
instructions: Cover the couscous with an equal volume of boiling water, add a pinch of salt and leave covered for 6 minutes.
Cut the halloumi into half inch slices and pat them completely dry.
Sear the halloumi in a dry non-stick skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until deeply golden.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and dress it with the olive oil and lemon juice.
Fold in the halved tomatoes, diced cucumber and chopped mint.
Lay the hot halloumi over the top and eat straight away while it is still squeaky.

name: Halloumi Burrito Bowls
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Slice the halloumi into thick strips.
Warm the black beans and corn in a small pan over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Pan-fry the halloumi in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Slice the avocado and roughly chop the cilantro.
Build the bowl with rice, the beans and corn, and salsa, then top with the halloumi.
Finish with sliced avocado, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Halloumi Fajita Bowls
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Slice the bell pepper and red onion into strips, and slice the halloumi into thick strips.
Heat a little oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the pepper and onion with the chili powder and cumin for 6 minutes until softened and charred at the edges.
Push the vegetables to one side and pan-fry the halloumi in the same skillet for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Roughly chop the cilantro.
Build the bowl with rice, the fajita vegetables, and the halloumi.
Top with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

name: Halloumi Gyros
instructions: Slice the halloumi into thick strips.
Mince the garlic and stir it into the Greek yogurt with a squeeze of lemon juice to make the sauce.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, thinly slice the red onion, and shred the romaine lettuce.
Pan-fry the halloumi in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with lettuce, tomatoes, red onion, and the grilled halloumi.
Drizzle with the garlic yogurt sauce and roll up tightly.

name: Halloumi Rice Bowls
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 15 minutes, then fluff and set aside.
Slice the halloumi and pan-fry in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Dice the cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Whisk the olive oil with the lemon juice to make a dressing.
Toss the cucumber and tomatoes with the dressing.
Spoon the rice into a bowl, top with the fried halloumi and dressed salad, and finish with chopped parsley.

name: Hand Pies (Butternut & Feta)
instructions: Dice the butternut squash and toss with the olive oil, then roast at 425°F for 20 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, dice the red onion and crumble the feta into a bowl.
Mash the roasted squash lightly and mix with the onion and feta to make the filling.
Roll out the puff pastry and cut into two rounds, then spoon the filling onto one half of each round.
Fold the pastry over the filling, crimp the edges with a fork, and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until puffed and golden brown.

name: Harissa Chickpea Wraps
instructions: Drain the chickpeas and pat them completely dry so they crisp instead of steaming.
Fry them in a skillet with a little oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, shaking the pan until the skins tighten and blister.
Stir in the harissa paste and 2 tablespoons of water and cook for 2 minutes until the chickpeas are glazed.
Slice the red onion and cucumber thinly while the chickpeas cool slightly.
Warm the wraps for 20 seconds per side in a dry pan.
Spread each wrap with hummus, pile in the spinach, chickpeas, onion and cucumber, then roll tightly and cut in half.

name: Harissa Roasted Cauliflower & Butter Bean Traybake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the cauliflower into small florets and slice the red onion.
Toss the cauliflower, onion, and butter beans with the harissa paste and olive oil on a baking tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, tossing halfway, until the cauliflower is charred at the edges.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the traybake.
Scatter with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Hearty Greek Smashed Potato Salad
instructions: Boil the whole potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes until fork-tender, then drain.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet and smash each one lightly with the bottom of a glass.
Drizzle with half the olive oil and roast at 425°F for 20 minutes until crisp and golden.
Meanwhile, halve the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion.
Whisk the remaining olive oil with the lemon juice to make a dressing.
Toss the roasted potatoes with the tomatoes, onion, crumbled feta, and dressing, then top with chopped parsley.

name: Homemade Burgers
instructions: Season the ground beef with salt and pepper and shape into two thin patties.
Sear the patties in a very hot skillet for 3 minutes per side.
Lay a slice of cheddar on each patty for the last minute to melt.
Toast the bun cut-side down in the same pan.
Spread the bun with mayonnaise and ketchup.
Stack the patties with lettuce, sliced tomato, and red onion, then close the bun.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Cube the chicken breast and mince the garlic.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Whisk the honey and soy sauce together and pour into the skillet, simmering for 3 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve the honey garlic chicken over the rice, topped with sliced green onions.

name: Honey Mustard Chicken Salad
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Whisk the Dijon mustard, honey, and olive oil together to make the dressing.
Brush half the honey mustard dressing over the chicken while it rests for 3 minutes, then slice.
Chop the romaine lettuce, halve the cherry tomatoes, and shave the carrot into a large bowl.
Toss the salad with the remaining dressing.
Top with the sliced honey mustard chicken before serving.

name: Honey Mustard Chicken Traybake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Cube the potatoes and slice the carrot into thick rounds.
Toss the potatoes and carrot with the olive oil and a pinch of salt on a baking tray.
Whisk the honey and dijon mustard together and brush half over the chicken thighs.
Nestle the chicken thighs among the vegetables on the tray.
Roast for 35-40 minutes, brushing with the remaining honey mustard halfway, until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and the vegetables are tender.
Rest for 3 minutes before serving straight from the tray.

name: Honey Mustard Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Halve the baby potatoes, toss them with the olive oil, thyme and salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Mix the mustard and honey and rub it all over the pork tenderloin.
Push the potatoes to the sides of the tray, lay the pork in the middle and roast for 18 minutes.
Add the trimmed green beans for the last 8 minutes so they keep some bite.
Rest the pork for 5 minutes before slicing it thickly, then spoon the tray juices over.

name: Hot Sauce Chicken & Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Cube the chicken breast and mince the garlic.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the hot sauce and butter and simmer for 2 minutes until the sauce is glossy and coats the chicken.
Serve the chicken over the rice, topped with sliced green onions.

name: Huevos Rancheros Bowl
instructions: Warm the crushed tomatoes with the cumin in a small saucepan over medium heat for 6 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the drained black beans and cook for 4 more minutes, crushing a few against the side of the pan.
Toast the tortillas in a dry skillet for 40 seconds per side until they blister and firm up.
Fry the eggs in the same skillet with a little oil over medium heat for 3 minutes, spooning hot oil over the whites.
Tear the tortillas into the bowl and spoon the beans over them.
Top with the fried eggs, sliced avocado, crumbled feta and cilantro.

name: Italian Sausage & Pepper Pasta
instructions: Squeeze the sausage meat out of its skins and fry it in a wide pan over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it into craggy pieces.
Add the sliced onion and pepper and cook for 8 minutes until softened and lightly caught at the edges.
Stir in the fennel seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce darkens.
Meanwhile boil the rigatoni in well salted water for 11 minutes, saving a cup of the water.
Toss the drained pasta through the sauce with a splash of the water, then finish with grated parmesan and torn basil.

name: Kale Green Sauce Rigatoni
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni for 10 minutes until al dente, reserving a cup of pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, strip the kale leaves and blanch in the same boiling water for 1 minute, then remove with tongs.
Blend the blanched kale, pesto, minced garlic, olive oil, and a splash of pasta water into a smooth green sauce.
Toss the drained rigatoni with the green sauce, adding more pasta water as needed to coat evenly.
Divide into a bowl and top with grated Parmesan.
Serve immediately while hot.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then spread it on a plate to cool and dry out.
Crumble the tofu and fry it in a hot wok with the sesame oil for 5 minutes until the edges turn golden.
Add the minced garlic and the roughly chopped kimchi and stir fry for 3 minutes so the kimchi caramelises.
Tip in the cooled rice and press it flat against the wok for 2 minutes to get some crust on the bottom.
Splash in the soy sauce and 2 tablespoons of the kimchi brine and toss everything together for 2 minutes.
Serve topped with the sliced spring onion.

name: Korean Beef Bulgogi Bowl
instructions: Freeze the steak for 15 minutes so it firms up, then slice it as thinly as you possibly can against the grain.
Grate the pear and mix it with the soy sauce, minced garlic and sesame oil, then marinate the beef in it for 10 minutes.
Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Heat a skillet until smoking and sear the beef in a single layer for 90 seconds per side so it caramelises instead of stewing.
Add the carrot matchsticks for the final minute and pour any leftover marinade in to bubble down.
Serve over the rice with plenty of sliced spring onion.

name: Korean Beef Rice Bowls
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Brown the ground beef in a hot skillet for 5 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil and simmer for 2 minutes.
Grate in the carrot and toss for 1 minute.
Serve over the rice and top with sliced green onions.

name: Korean Chicken Rice Bowls
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Cube the chicken thighs and mince the garlic.
Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 7-8 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Whisk the soy sauce and honey together and pour into the skillet with the garlic, simmering for 3 minutes until glossy.
Julienne the carrot while the sauce simmers.
Build the bowls with rice topped with the glazed chicken and julienned carrot.
Finish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

name: Lemon Chicken & Orzo Soup
instructions: Dice the carrot and celery and sauté them in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 7 minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring it to a gentle simmer.
Lower the whole chicken breast into the broth and poach it for 14 minutes until cooked through, then lift it out.
Add the orzo to the broth and cook for 9 minutes until tender.
Shred the chicken with two forks and return it to the pot with the spinach.
Take off the heat and stir in the lemon juice and dill, then season generously.

name: Lemon Chicken Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through to 165°F; set aside.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the chicken broth and the juice of the lemon, simmering for 2 minutes and scraping up any browned bits.
Slice the chicken and return it to the skillet, tossing to coat in the lemon sauce.
Serve the chicken and sauce over the rice, finished with chopped parsley.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Linguine
instructions: Boil the linguine in well salted water for 9 minutes until al dente, saving a cup of the cooking water.
Meanwhile pat the shrimp completely dry and season them with salt.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the sliced garlic and chili flakes for 90 seconds until pale gold.
Raise the heat and sear the shrimp for 90 seconds per side until they curl and turn opaque.
Add the drained pasta with a splash of the cooking water and toss for 1 minute until a glossy sauce forms.
Take off the heat, add the lemon zest and juice and the chopped parsley, and toss again before serving.

name: Lemon Herb Chickpea Salad
instructions: Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes, shaking the pan until they start to pop, then tip onto a plate to cool.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas well and pat them dry so the dressing clings.
Dice the cucumber and tomato into half inch pieces and slice the red onion as thinly as you can.
Whisk the olive oil with the juice of the lemon, a pinch of salt and plenty of black pepper.
Toss the chickpeas and vegetables through the dressing and leave to sit for 5 minutes so the onion mellows.
Fold in the chopped parsley and scatter the toasted seeds over the top.

name: Lemon Herb Salmon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Halve the baby potatoes and toss with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the potatoes for 20 minutes until they begin to turn golden.
Mince the garlic and mix with the remaining olive oil, lemon zest, and chopped parsley.
Push the potatoes to one side, add the green beans, and place the salmon skin-side down on the sheet.
Brush the salmon with the garlic herb mixture and roast for 12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the salmon before serving with the roasted potatoes and green beans.

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Boil the peeled and chunked potatoes in salted water for 18 minutes until a knife slides through easily, then drain.
While they cook, sauté the diced onion and carrot in a pan with half the oil over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, thyme, rinsed lentils and broth, then simmer for 22 minutes until the lentils are soft and the sauce is thick.
Mash the potatoes with the remaining olive oil, a splash of the cooking water and plenty of salt.
Spoon the lentils into a small baking dish, spread the mash over the top and rough it up with a fork.
Bake for 20 minutes until the peaks are golden and the edges bubble.

name: Loaded Taco Fries
instructions: Bake the fries at 425°F for 20 minutes until crisp.
Brown the ground beef in a skillet for 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pile the fries onto a plate and top with the beef and shredded cheddar.
Return to the oven for 3 minutes to melt the cheese.
Finish with salsa, sour cream, and sliced green onions.

name: Low Cal Chicken Curry
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 4 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-size pieces, and dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat a nonstick saucepan with a light spray of oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in the cumin and chili powder and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken and diced tomatoes, then simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve the curry over the rice, topped with chopped cilantro.

name: Low Cal Katsu Curry
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Butterfly the chicken breast and pound it to an even thickness.
Dust the chicken in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat in panko, then pan-fry in a little oil for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Meanwhile, finely dice the onion and soften it in a saucepan with a splash of oil over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and cook for 30 seconds, then pour in the chicken broth and simmer for 6 minutes until slightly thickened.
Blend the sauce until smooth using a stick blender.
Slice the katsu chicken and serve over the rice, topped with the curry sauce.

name: Mac & Cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, whisk in the flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer until thickened.
Stir in most of the cheddar and the dijon mustard until smooth.
Fold in the macaroni and transfer to a small baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheddar and the panko, then bake for 12 minutes until golden.

name: Maple Glazed Ham & Potato Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the potatoes into thin rounds, toss them with the olive oil and salt and spread them over a baking tray.
Roast for 22 minutes until the edges are crisp and browned.
Mix the maple syrup with the mustard and brush it over both sides of the ham.
Lay the ham on the potatoes with the trimmed green beans around it and roast for 12 more minutes.
Scatter the grated cheddar over and return to the oven for 4 minutes until it melts.

name: Margherita Flatbread Pizza
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°F with a baking sheet inside so it gets screaming hot.
Mix the crushed tomatoes with the grated garlic, oregano, a pinch of salt and half the olive oil.
Spread the sauce over the flatbread, leaving a half inch border.
Tear the mozzarella and dot it over the sauce rather than covering it completely.
Slide the flatbread onto the hot sheet and bake for 9 minutes until the cheese blisters and the base is crisp.
Tear the basil over and finish with the last of the olive oil.

name: Meatball Pasta
instructions: Mix the ground beef with the panko, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt, then roll into small meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in a skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Pour in the marinara, cover, and simmer for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the penne in salted boiling water until al dente.
Toss the pasta through the sauce and meatballs.
Serve topped with grated parmesan and torn basil.

name: Mediterranean Baked Cod
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Slice the baby potatoes into thin rounds, toss with half the olive oil, the oregano and salt, and roast for 20 minutes.
Scatter the cherry tomatoes, olives and smashed garlic over the potatoes and roast for 5 more minutes.
Lay the seasoned cod on top, brush with the rest of the oil and add a few lemon slices.
Bake for 11 minutes until the fish turns opaque and flakes easily at the thickest point.
Squeeze the remaining lemon over and spoon the roasting juices around the fish.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Orzo Salad
instructions: Cook the orzo in boiling salted water for 9 minutes until tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then dice it into cubes.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the red onion into a large bowl with the cooked orzo.
Whisk the olive oil with the lemon juice and toss through the orzo with the crumbled feta.
Top with the diced chicken before serving.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Salad
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Rest for 3 minutes, then slice into strips.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Chop the romaine lettuce and halve the cherry tomatoes into a large bowl with the chickpeas.
Whisk the olive oil with the lemon juice and toss through the salad with the crumbled feta.
Top with the sliced chicken before serving.

name: Mediterranean Halloumi Pasta
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 9 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Slice the halloumi and pan-fry in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden, then set aside.
Dice the zucchini and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Heat the olive oil in the same skillet and sauté the zucchini, tomatoes, and minced garlic for 6 minutes until softened.
Toss the pasta with the vegetables and a splash of pasta water to loosen the sauce.
Plate the pasta, top with the fried halloumi, and scatter with torn basil.

name: Mediterranean Orzo Salad
instructions: Boil the orzo in well salted water for 9 minutes until al dente, then drain and rinse briefly in cold water.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and dice the cucumber into small cubes.
Whisk the olive oil with the lemon juice and a good pinch of salt.
Toss the orzo through the dressing while it is still slightly warm so it absorbs the lemon.
Fold in the chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber and olives.
Tear the basil over just before serving and add plenty of black pepper.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa & Roasted Vegetable Bowl
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Chop the zucchini, bell pepper, and red onion, toss with olive oil, and roast for 20 minutes with the chickpeas.
Rinse the quinoa and simmer it in water for 15 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Build the bowl with quinoa, roasted vegetables, chickpeas, and tomatoes.
Top with a swoosh of hummus and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Mediterranean Salmon Bowls
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in water for 15 minutes until the grains open up and the liquid is absorbed.
Pat the salmon dry, season with salt and pepper, and sear in a skillet with a little olive oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, and thinly slice the red onion.
Flake the cooked salmon into large pieces.
Fluff the quinoa and toss with the olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Assemble bowls with the quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and flaked salmon.
Crumble the feta cheese over the top before serving.

name: Mexican Chicken Skillet
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Cube the chicken breast and slice the bell pepper.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6-7 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Add the bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes until slightly softened.
Stir in the black beans, corn, chili powder, and cooked rice, and cook for 3 minutes until heated through.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top and let it melt for 1 minute off the heat.
Finish with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Mexican Loaded Sweet Potato Boats
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Prick the sweet potato all over and bake for 35 minutes until tender.
Warm the black beans and corn in a pan with the taco seasoning.
Split the sweet potato open and fluff the inside with a fork.
Load with the bean mixture, salsa, and shredded cheddar.
Return to the oven for 3 minutes to melt the cheese.
Top with sliced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Microwave Burrito Bowl
instructions: Put the rice in a deep microwave-safe bowl with double its volume of water and a pinch of salt.
Cover loosely and microwave on high for 10 minutes, then leave it to stand covered for 4 minutes.
Mix the drained black beans, corn and cumin in a second microwave-safe bowl and heat on high for 2 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir the lime juice through it.
Spoon the beans and corn over the rice and add the salsa.
Top with sliced avocado and cilantro and season with salt.

name: Microwave Loaded Sweet Potato
instructions: Prick the sweet potato all over with a fork and microwave it on high for 8 minutes, turning it once halfway.
Check it gives easily when squeezed, and give it 2 more minutes in the microwave if it is still firm.
Put the drained black beans, corn and smoked paprika in a microwave-safe bowl and heat on high for 2 minutes.
Split the hot sweet potato down the middle and fluff the flesh with a fork.
Pile the bean mixture in and season with salt and the juice of the lime.
Top with the yogurt and the sliced spring onion.

name: Minestrone with White Beans
instructions: Dice the carrot and celery small and sauté them in a pot with a little oil over medium heat for 7 minutes.
Add the sliced garlic and cook for 1 minute until it smells sweet rather than sharp.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and the broth, bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the macaroni and cook for 8 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the drained cannellini beans and the shredded kale and simmer for 4 more minutes.
Season generously with salt and black pepper and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Mini Pizza Bagels
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice the bagel in half and place both halves cut-side up on the sheet.
Spread the marinara sauce evenly over each half.
Scatter the shredded mozzarella over the sauce, then top with sliced pepperoni.
Bake for 10 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbling and the edges are golden.
Sprinkle with torn basil and red pepper flakes before serving.

name: Miso Glazed Cod
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a small baking dish.
Mix the miso paste, maple syrup and grated ginger into a thick glaze.
Pat the cod dry, spread the glaze over the top and bake for 12 minutes until the fish flakes at the thickest point.
Meanwhile simmer the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes.
Steam the halved bok choy over the rice for the last 4 minutes until the stems are just tender.
Serve the cod on the rice with the bok choy and a scatter of sesame seeds.

name: Miso Glazed Eggplant Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Halve the eggplant lengthways and score the cut faces in a deep criss-cross pattern without piercing the skin.
Brush with the sesame oil and bake cut side up for 20 minutes until the flesh collapses inwards.
Mix the miso paste with the maple syrup and 1 tablespoon of water, spread it over the eggplant and bake for 8 more minutes until lacquered.
Meanwhile simmer the rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and boil the edamame for 3 minutes.
Serve the eggplant on the rice with the edamame and sliced spring onion.

name: Miso Mushroom Ramen
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat and fry the sliced shiitake for 5 minutes until deeply browned at the edges.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in 2 cups of water, bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes to build the broth.
Take the pan off the heat, whisk the miso paste with a ladle of the hot broth in a small bowl, then stir it back in so it never boils.
Return to a low simmer, add the ramen noodles and the halved bok choy and cook for 4 minutes.
Ladle into a deep bowl and finish with the sliced spring onion.

name: Mongolian Beef Lettuce Cups
instructions: Slice the steak as thinly as you can against the grain and toss it with the cornstarch.
Heat a wok until smoking, add the sesame oil and sear the beef in a single layer for 90 seconds per side.
Push the beef to one side and add the minced garlic and grated ginger for 30 seconds.
Pour in the soy sauce with 3 tablespoons of water and a teaspoon of sugar and let it bubble for 2 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the beef through the glaze with most of the sliced spring onion.
Separate the romaine into cup shaped leaves and spoon the beef in, topping with the rest of the spring onion.

name: Mongolian Beef Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Slice the sirloin steak into thin strips and toss in the flour to coat lightly.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over high heat and sear the beef for 3-4 minutes, turning, until browned.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Whisk the soy sauce and honey together and pour into the skillet, simmering for 2-3 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened.
Serve the Mongolian beef over the rice, topped with sliced green onions.

name: Moroccan Chickpea & Apricot Tagine
instructions: Dice the onion and cook in a pot with a splash of olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, chickpeas, and quartered apricots.
Add a splash of water, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover and simmer for 5 more minutes to thicken slightly.
Scatter with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Tagine
instructions: Sauté the diced onion in a heavy pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the cumin and cinnamon and cook for 1 minute so the spices bloom in the oil.
Stir in the cubed butternut squash, the crushed tomatoes and 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 18 minutes until the squash is tender at the centre.
Add the drained chickpeas and cook uncovered for 5 more minutes so the sauce reduces and clings.
Cover the couscous with an equal volume of boiling water, leave for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve the tagine on top with the parsley.

name: Moroccan Harissa Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cube the sweet potato, zucchini, and bell pepper.
Toss the vegetables and chickpeas with the harissa paste and olive oil on a baking tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, tossing halfway, until the vegetables are tender and caramelized.
Scatter with chopped cilantro.
Serve warm straight from the tray.

name: Mushroom & Barley Stew
instructions: Fry the quartered mushrooms in a pot with the olive oil over high heat for 7 minutes until they release their water and start to brown.
Add the diced onion and carrot and cook for 6 minutes over medium heat.
Stir in the tomato paste and thyme and cook for 2 minutes to deepen the colour.
Add the rinsed barley and the broth, bring to a boil then reduce to a low simmer.
Cover and cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the barley is plump and the stew has thickened.
Season with salt and plenty of black pepper before serving.

name: Mushroom & Gruyère Melts
instructions: Slice the mushrooms thickly and fry them in a dry skillet over high heat for 5 minutes until they give up their water.
Add half the butter, the minced garlic and the thyme and cook for 3 more minutes until deeply browned.
Spread the mustard on one slice of bread and pile the mushrooms and grated gruyère on top.
Close the sandwich and butter the outside of both slices.
Fry it in the same pan over medium-low heat for 4 minutes per side, pressing down with a spatula, until the cheese runs.
Rest for 1 minute before cutting so the filling sets.

name: Mushroom & Pea Risotto
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer.
Sauté the sliced mushrooms in half the butter until golden, then set aside.
Soften the diced onion and garlic in the remaining butter for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and toast for 1 minute.
Add the broth a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed, for about 18 minutes.
Stir in the peas and mushrooms for the final 3 minutes.
Finish with grated parmesan and a crack of black pepper.

name: Mushroom Pasta Bake
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 8 minutes until just shy of al dente, then drain.
Slice the mushrooms and mince the garlic.
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the mushrooms and garlic for 7 minutes until golden.
Pour in the heavy cream and simmer for 3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Toss the pasta with the mushroom sauce and transfer to an oven-safe dish, then top with shredded mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden, then sprinkle with parsley.

name: Mushroom Stroganoff
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain.
Sear the sliced mushrooms in butter over high heat for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 3 minutes, then stir in the garlic and paprika.
Pour in the vegetable broth and simmer for 3 minutes.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the sour cream.
Serve the sauce over the noodles with a pinch of extra paprika.

name: Mushroom Walnut Ragù Pasta
instructions: Pulse the mushrooms and walnuts in a food processor until finely chopped but not pureed.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the mushroom-walnut mixture and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fragrant.
Stir in the strained tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until the ragù thickens.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, drain, and toss with the ragù and grated Parmesan.

name: One Pan Fish Finger & Chips Traybake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Spread the fish fingers and fries on a single baking tray.
Bake for 18 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Boil the peas in a small pot of water for 3 minutes, then drain.
Plate the fish fingers and fries with the peas.
Serve with ketchup on the side.

name: One Pot Chicken Rice
instructions: Dice the onion and carrot and mince the garlic.
Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Heat a splash of oil in a pot over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden; set aside.
Add the onion and carrot to the pot and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic and rinsed rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring to coat.
Pour in the chicken broth, nestle the chicken back into the pot, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer over low heat for 18-20 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F internally.

name: Paneer Curry
instructions: Cube the paneer and pan-fry in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 4 minutes until golden on all sides, then set aside.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic and ginger.
Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger in the same skillet for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the ground cumin and diced tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Pour in the coconut milk and return the paneer to the pan, simmering for 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 15 minutes, then serve the curry over the rice.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala
instructions: Cut the paneer into 1 inch cubes and sear them in a hot skillet with a little oil for 4 minutes until browned in patches, then lift out.
Sauté the diced onion in the same pan over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the grated ginger and garam masala and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce darkens and thickens.
Stir in the cream, return the paneer and simmer gently for 4 minutes.
Boil the basmati rice in salted water for 10 minutes, drain, and serve the curry over it with cilantro.

name: Paneer Tikka Rice
instructions: Cube the paneer and toss with the Greek yogurt, minced garlic, ground cumin, and smoked paprika to marinate for 10 minutes.
Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then fluff and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the marinated paneer for 2 minutes per side until charred at the edges.
Add the diced bell pepper to the skillet and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Toss the rice into the skillet with the paneer and pepper and stir for 2 minutes to combine and heat through.
Spoon into a bowl to serve.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
instructions: Cook the penne in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Warm the olive oil with the sliced garlic and red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the strained tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water.
Tear in the basil and serve.

name: Peri Peri Chicken Traybake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Halve the baby potatoes and cut the pepper and onion into thick wedges.
Toss the vegetables with the olive oil and salt, spread them on a large tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Coat the chicken thighs in the peri peri sauce and nestle them skin side up among the vegetables.
Roast for 25 more minutes until the chicken is deeply coloured and the juices run clear.
Squeeze the lemon over the whole tray and let it sit for 3 minutes before serving.

name: Peri Peri Chicken Wraps
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into strips and toss with the hot sauce, smoked paprika, and a squeeze of lemon.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 7-8 minutes, stirring, until browned and cooked through to 165°F.
Shred the romaine lettuce while the chicken cooks.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Spread a spoon of sour cream down the center of each tortilla.
Fill with the peri peri chicken and shredded lettuce.
Roll the tortillas tightly into wraps and slice in half to serve.

name: Peri Peri Salmon Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Pat the salmon dry, brush generously with the peri peri sauce, and place on a lined baking sheet.
Slice the bell pepper and red onion and scatter around the salmon.
Roast for 14 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and the peppers are lightly charred.
Fluff the rice and squeeze the lime juice through it.
Serve the peri peri salmon and roasted peppers over the rice, topped with chopped cilantro.

name: Philly Cheesesteak Melt
instructions: Freeze the steak for 15 minutes, then slice it as thinly as possible against the grain.
Heat half the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the sliced onion, pepper and mushrooms for 10 minutes until soft and caramelised.
Push the vegetables aside, raise the heat and sear the beef in one layer for 90 seconds per side.
Chop everything together in the pan with the edge of the spatula and season well.
Lay the provolone over the top, drop the heat to low and cover for 2 minutes until it melts.
Split the baguette, toast the cut sides in the pan for 1 minute and pile the filling in.

name: Piri Piri Rice Pots
instructions: Dice the chicken breast and toss it with the smoked paprika and a pinch of salt.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the sliced bell pepper, red onion, and minced garlic, and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the rice and hot sauce, then pour in 1 cup of water.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and spoon into a bowl to serve.

name: Pork & Apple Burgers
instructions: Coarsely grate half the apple and squeeze out the excess juice with your hands.
Mix it into the ground pork with the chopped sage, plenty of salt and black pepper, then shape two patties wider than the bun.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the patties for 5 minutes per side until the juices run clear.
Slice the rest of the apple and the red onion thinly.
Toast the cut sides of the bun in the same pan for 1 minute to soak up the fat.
Spread the mustard on the base and stack the lettuce, patties, apple and onion.

name: Pork & Ginger Noodle Soup
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a pot over high heat and fry the ground pork for 6 minutes, breaking it up until browned and crisp in places.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in 2.5 cups of water and the soy sauce, bring to a boil and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the rice noodles and cook for 4 minutes until tender.
Drop in the halved bok choy for the last 2 minutes so the leaves wilt but the stems stay crisp.
Ladle into a deep bowl and top with the sliced spring onion.

name: Pork Larb Lettuce Cups
instructions: Toast the raw rice in a dry skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes until golden, then crush it coarsely into a rough powder.
Raise the heat and fry the ground pork in the same pan for 7 minutes, breaking it up so it browns rather than steams.
Add the sliced shallot and the chili flakes and cook for 2 minutes.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the soy sauce and the juice of one lime.
Fold in the toasted rice powder and the torn mint just before serving so they stay fragrant.
Separate the romaine into cup shaped leaves and spoon the larb into them.

name: Prawn Katsu Curry
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Pat the shrimp dry, then dredge in the flour, dip in the beaten egg, and coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Heat a shallow layer of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry the shrimp for 2 minutes per side until golden and crisp; drain on paper towels.
In a separate saucepan, whisk the curry powder into the coconut milk and soy sauce and simmer for 6 minutes until slightly thickened.
Fluff the rice and spoon it into a bowl.
Pour the katsu curry sauce over the rice and top with the crispy shrimp.

name: Prawn Stir Fry
instructions: Peel and devein the shrimp, then pat dry and season with a pinch of salt.
Slice the carrot and bell pepper into thin strips and chop the broccoli into small florets.
Mince the garlic.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the shrimp for 2 minutes until pink; remove and set aside.
Add the broccoli, carrot, and bell pepper to the wok and stir-fry for 5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return the shrimp to the wok with the garlic and soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes until everything is coated and heated through.

name: Protein Burritos
instructions: Dice the chicken breast and toss with the taco seasoning.
Sear the chicken in a hot skillet with a little oil for 7 minutes until cooked through.
Push the chicken to one side, crack in the eggs, and scramble them in the same skillet for 2 minutes.
Stir in the black beans and warm through for 2 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with the chicken and egg mixture, shredded cheddar, and salsa.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly to serve.

name: Pulled Chicken Burritos
instructions: Rinse the rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Season the chicken thighs with the chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Place the chicken in a pot with the chicken broth, bring to a simmer, and cook covered for 20 minutes until it reaches 165°F and shreds easily.
Remove the chicken and shred it with two forks, then stir it back into the remaining broth in the pot.
Warm the black beans in a small pan for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side.
Layer the rice, shredded chicken, black beans, cheddar, and salsa onto the tortilla.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly into a burrito to serve.

name: Pulled Pork Tacos
instructions: Cut the pork shoulder into large chunks and season them with the cumin and salt.
Sear the pork in a heavy pot over high heat for 6 minutes until browned on several sides.
Add the chipotle paste, half the sliced onion and 1 cup of water, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the meat shreds easily.
Shred the pork with two forks and let it bubble uncovered for 4 minutes so it soaks up the last of the sauce.
Shred the cabbage and toss it with the rest of the onion and the juice of one lime.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds a side and load them with pork, slaw and cilantro.

name: Quinoa Tabbouleh Bowl
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then simmer it in a saucepan with double its volume of salted water for 14 minutes.
Take the pan off the heat, cover and rest for 5 minutes, then spread the quinoa on a plate to cool quickly.
Finely dice the cucumber and tomato and chop the parsley and mint as small as you can manage.
Whisk the olive oil with the juice of the lemon and a good pinch of salt.
Toss the cooled quinoa, chickpeas, vegetables and herbs through the dressing.
Leave for 5 minutes before eating so the grains soak up the lemon.

name: Ramen with Egg & Veg
instructions: Boil the egg in a small pot of water for 7 minutes, then cool, peel, and halve.
Bring the vegetable broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the broccoli florets and sliced carrot and simmer for 4 minutes.
Add the egg noodles and cook for 4 minutes until tender.
Ladle the ramen into a bowl and top with the halved egg.
Scatter with sliced green onions before serving.

name: Ricotta & Spinach Gnocchi Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Boil the gnocchi in salted water for 2 minutes until they float, then drain.
Wilt the spinach with the minced garlic in a skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Mix the gnocchi, wilted spinach, ricotta, and marinara sauce in a baking dish.
Scatter the mozzarella over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden on top.

name: Roasted Aubergine & Gnocchi Traybake
instructions: Cube the eggplant and toss with the olive oil, cherry tomatoes, and sliced red onion on a baking tray.
Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes until the eggplant is tender and lightly charred.
Scatter the gnocchi over the tray and toss to coat in the tray juices.
Return to the oven and roast for 12 minutes until the gnocchi are golden and slightly crisp.
Crumble the feta over the top and return to the oven for 3 minutes to soften.
Scatter with torn basil before serving.

name: Roasted Aubergine Hummus Bowls
instructions: Cube the eggplant and toss with the olive oil and chickpeas on a baking tray.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes, tossing halfway, until the eggplant is tender and the chickpeas are crisp.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Spread the hummus in the base of a bowl.
Top with the roasted eggplant, chickpeas, and cherry tomatoes.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and chopped parsley to finish.

name: Roasted Pepper & White Bean Stew
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and roast the halved bell peppers for 20 minutes until charred and soft.
Peel and chop the roasted peppers once cool enough to handle.
Dice the onion and cook in a pot with the olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the roasted peppers, cannellini beans, and strained tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Scatter with torn basil before serving.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Pasta
instructions: Cover the cashews with boiling water and leave them to soften while everything else cooks.
Boil the penne in well salted water for 10 minutes until al dente, saving a cup of the cooking water before draining.
Sauté the sliced garlic in the olive oil over low heat for 2 minutes until pale gold, never letting it brown.
Blend the drained cashews, red peppers, garlic, nutritional yeast and a splash of the pasta water into a smooth sauce.
Return the sauce to the pan over low heat, add the pasta and spinach and toss for 2 minutes, loosening with more pasta water as needed.
Season with salt, black pepper and a little more nutritional yeast on top.

name: Roasted Veg Pasta Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Chop the zucchini, bell pepper, and red onion, toss with olive oil, and roast for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the penne for 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Stir the pasta, roasted vegetables, cherry tomatoes, and strained tomatoes together in a baking dish.
Top with torn mozzarella.
Bake for 15 minutes until the cheese is golden and bubbling.

name: Roasted Veggie & Hummus Bowl
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the zucchini, pepper and onion into thick chunks, toss with the olive oil and oregano and spread on a baking sheet.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until the edges are blackened in places.
Meanwhile simmer the quinoa in a saucepan with double its volume of salted water for 14 minutes and rest covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff the quinoa with a fork and squeeze half the lemon over it.
Spoon the hummus into a bowl, pile the quinoa and hot vegetables on top and finish with the rest of the lemon.

name: Root Vegetable Thai Curry
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Peel and cube the sweet potato and slice the carrot.
Dice the onion and cook in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Stir in the grated ginger and curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sweet potato, carrot, and coconut milk, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the curry over the rice, scattered with chopped cilantro.

name: Salmon Poke Bowl
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then fold the rice vinegar through and let it cool to warm.
Boil the edamame in salted water for 3 minutes and drain.
Sear the salmon in a hot skillet skin side down for 4 minutes, then 2 minutes on the flesh side, so the centre stays just translucent.
Flake the salmon into large chunks and toss them gently with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Slice the cucumber into thin half moons and the avocado into wedges.
Build the bowl with rice, salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado and spoon any leftover dressing over.

name: Salmon Rice Bowls
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, then fluff with a fork.
Pat the salmon dry, season with salt and pepper, and sear in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until it flakes easily.
Flake the salmon into large chunks.
Dice the cucumber and slice the avocado.
Divide the rice between bowls and top with the salmon, cucumber, and avocado.
Drizzle with soy sauce and scatter sesame seeds and sliced green onions on top.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Noodles
instructions: Boil the egg noodles for 4 minutes, adding the broccoli for the last 2 minutes, then drain both and rinse briefly.
Pat the salmon dry and season it with salt.
Sear it skin side down in a hot skillet for 5 minutes without moving it, then turn and cook for 2 more minutes.
Lift the salmon out and add the grated ginger and carrot matchsticks to the pan for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, broccoli and teriyaki sauce and toss for 2 minutes until glossy.
Flake the salmon over the noodles and finish with sesame seeds.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Steam the broccoli florets for 5 minutes until bright green and tender.
Pat the salmon dry and sear in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side.
Pour the teriyaki sauce into the skillet and simmer for 2 minutes, spooning it over the salmon until glazed and sticky.
Fluff the rice and divide between bowls with the broccoli.
Top with the teriyaki salmon, spooning over any extra glaze from the pan, and sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions.

name: Salt & Pepper Chicken
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Cube the chicken breast and toss it in the flour with the black pepper and a pinch of salt.
Heat a generous splash of oil in a skillet over high heat and fry the chicken for 5-6 minutes, turning, until crispy and cooked through to 165°F.
Drain the chicken on paper towel and wipe out most of the oil from the skillet.
Slice the bell pepper and mince the garlic, then stir-fry both in the skillet for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Toss the crispy chicken back through the peppers and garlic.
Serve over the rice, topped with sliced green onions.

name: Sardine & Tomato Pasta
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water for 10 minutes, then drain, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the minced garlic and red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until they start to break down.
Flake in the sardines and cook for 2 minutes, stirring gently to combine.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce, loosening with the reserved pasta water.
Scatter with chopped parsley before serving.

name: Saucy Chicken Teriyaki Noodles
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water according to the package, then drain and set aside.
Slice the chicken into thin strips and mince the garlic.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and sear the chicken for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the broccoli florets, sliced carrot, and garlic and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Pour in the teriyaki sauce with a splash of water and toss to coat everything, simmering for 2 minutes until saucy.
Add the noodles and toss for 1 minute to combine.
Scatter with sesame seeds to serve.

name: Sauerkraut & Potato Hash
instructions: Cut the potatoes into half inch cubes and boil them in salted water for 8 minutes, then drain well and let the steam escape.
Heat the olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat and add the potatoes in a single layer.
Fry them undisturbed for 6 minutes so a crust forms, then turn and cook 4 minutes more.
Push the potatoes to one side, add the sliced onion and smoked paprika and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the drained white beans and the squeezed out sauerkraut and cook for 3 minutes just to warm through.
Take off the heat, scatter with the dill and season with black pepper.

name: Sausage & White Bean Casserole
instructions: Brown the sausages whole in a heavy pot over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, turning until coloured all over, then lift them out.
Sauté the diced onion and carrot in the same pot for 7 minutes, scraping up the sticky bits.
Add the sliced garlic and chopped rosemary and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes with half a cup of water, return the sausages and simmer for 15 minutes.
Slice the sausages into thick coins, add the drained beans and simmer uncovered for 8 more minutes.
Toast the sourdough in a dry skillet for 2 minutes a side and serve alongside for mopping.

name: Sausage Bean Stew
instructions: Slice the sausages into rounds and brown in a pot over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Dice the onion and carrot and mince the garlic, then add to the pot and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Add the butter beans and simmer for 12 minutes until the stew thickens slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle into a bowl to serve.

name: Sausage Casserole
instructions: Brown the sausages in an oven-safe pot over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, then remove and set aside.
Dice the onion, carrot, and potatoes and mince the garlic, then sauté in the same pot for 6 minutes.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and vegetable broth and return the sausages to the pot.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.

name: Sausage Pasta
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 10 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of its casing into a skillet and brown over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic, then add to the skillet and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the strained tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thickened.
Toss the pasta with the sausage sauce.
Plate and top with grated Parmesan and torn basil.

name: Sausage Pepper Penne Ragu
instructions: Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain, reserving 0.5 cup of the pasta water.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of its casing into a hot skillet and brown for 5 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon.
Dice the bell pepper and onion, mince the garlic, and add them to the skillet, cooking for 4 minutes until softened.
Pour in the strained tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes until thickened.
Add the drained penne and a splash of the reserved pasta water, tossing to coat.
Simmer for 1 minute until the sauce clings to the pasta.
Grate the parmesan over the top to serve.

name: Sesame Crusted Tuna Bowl
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then stir the rice vinegar through it.
Pat the tuna loin completely dry and season it with salt on both sides.
Press the sesame seeds firmly onto every surface of the tuna.
Sear it in a very hot skillet with a little oil for 90 seconds per side so the centre stays ruby.
Rest the tuna for 3 minutes, then slice it against the grain into thick pieces.
Build the bowl with rice, sliced cucumber and avocado, lay the tuna on top and finish with soy sauce and spring onion.

name: Sesame Peanut Noodles
instructions: Boil a pot of water, drop in the rice noodles off the heat and leave for 6 minutes until just tender, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, the juice of the lime and 3 tablespoons of warm water into a pourable sauce.
Cut the carrot into matchsticks and shred the red cabbage as finely as possible.
Warm a large skillet over high heat and stir fry the carrot and cabbage for 2 minutes so they keep their bite.
Add the drained noodles and the peanut sauce and toss for 1 minute until every strand is coated.
Serve topped with the sliced spring onion.

name: Sesame Soba Noodle Salad
instructions: Boil the soba noodles in a large pot of unsalted water for 5 minutes, stirring so they do not clump.
Add the edamame to the same pot for the final 3 minutes.
Drain both and rinse under cold running water until completely cool, then shake dry.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into fine matchsticks.
Whisk the soy sauce, sesame oil and rice vinegar together with 1 teaspoon of sugar.
Toss the noodles, edamame and vegetables through the dressing and finish with the sesame seeds.

name: Shakshuka with Feta
instructions: Sauté the sliced onion and pepper in a skillet with a splash of oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the cumin and cook for 1 minute, stirring so it does not catch.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes until the sauce thickens enough to hold a trench.
Make two wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each one.
Cover the pan and cook over low heat for 6 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks still wobble.
Crumble the feta over, scatter with cilantro and serve with toasted sourdough for scooping.

name: Sheet Pan Salmon & Asparagus
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Halve the baby potatoes, toss them with half the olive oil and a good pinch of salt and roast for 18 minutes.
Trim the asparagus and add it to the tray with the smashed garlic cloves.
Nestle the salmon among the vegetables, brush it with the rest of the oil and season with salt.
Roast for 11 more minutes until the salmon is just opaque in the centre and flakes under gentle pressure.
Squeeze the lemon over the whole tray and scatter with dill before serving.

name: Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Peel and chop the potatoes, then boil in salted water for 15 minutes until fork-tender.
Dice the carrot and brown the ground beef with it in a skillet over medium-high heat for 8 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and stir in the frozen peas, then simmer for 8 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk until smooth.
Spread the beef and pea filling into an oven-safe dish and top with the mashed potato.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until the top is golden and the filling is bubbling.

name: Shrimp & Mango Salad
instructions: Pat the shrimp dry and season them with salt and a pinch of chili if you like heat.
Sear them in a very hot skillet with the olive oil for 90 seconds per side until pink and lightly charred.
Slice the red onion paper thin and soak it in the juice of one lime for 5 minutes.
Dice the mango into cubes and shred the romaine into wide ribbons.
Toss the lettuce, mango, black beans and onion with the limey soaking juice.
Lay the warm shrimp over the top and scatter with cilantro.

name: Shrimp & Pea Paella
instructions: Sauté the diced onion and pepper in a wide shallow pan with the olive oil over medium heat for 7 minutes.
Stir in the smoked paprika and the saffron and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes so every grain is coated in the oil.
Pour in 1.5 cups of hot water, spread the rice flat and simmer without stirring for 15 minutes.
Scatter the peas and shrimp over the top, press them in lightly and cook for 6 more minutes.
Turn the heat to high for the last 60 seconds to catch the bottom, then rest off the heat for 5 minutes.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then spread it out to cool and dry.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and scramble the beaten egg for 40 seconds, then tip it out.
Sear the dried shrimp in the same wok for 90 seconds per side until pink, then set them aside with the egg.
Add the minced garlic and the peas and stir fry for 2 minutes.
Tip in the cold rice, press it against the wok for 1 minute to crisp, then toss for 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp and egg, splash in the soy sauce and finish with the sliced spring onion.

name: Slow Cooked Beef & Chocolate Chilli
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F. Cut the steak into 1-inch chunks and dice the onion; mince the garlic.
Heat an ovenproof pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef chunks for 6 minutes on all sides.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in the chili powder and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and kidney beans, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and transfer to the oven, cooking for 2.5 hours until the beef is fork-tender.
Stir in the dark chocolate until melted and season with salt to taste before serving.

name: Smash Burger with Slaw
instructions: Shred the cabbage finely and toss it with the mayonnaise, vinegar, sliced onion and a pinch of salt.
Divide the beef into two loose balls without compacting them and season the outsides heavily.
Heat a cast iron skillet until it is almost smoking.
Put the balls in the dry pan and smash each one flat with a spatula, then leave them untouched for 2 minutes to build a crust.
Flip, lay the cheddar on top and cook for 1 more minute until it melts.
Toast the bun in the beef fat for 30 seconds, spread with mustard and stack the patties and slaw.

name: Smashed White Bean Toasts
instructions: Toast the sourdough in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until crisp at the edges.
Rub the hot slices with the cut side of the garlic clove while they are still warm.
Warm the drained beans in the same pan with the olive oil for 3 minutes.
Crush about half the beans with a fork so the mix becomes creamy but still has texture.
Stir in the lemon juice and season firmly with salt and black pepper.
Pile onto the toast, top with the halved cherry tomatoes and tear the basil over.

name: Smoked Mackerel & Beet Bowl
instructions: Simmer the pearl barley in a pot of salted water for 22 minutes until chewy but tender, then drain.
Cut the cooked beets into wedges and slice the apple into thin matchsticks.
Whisk the mustard with the olive oil and a splash of water into a loose dressing.
Toss the warm barley through half the dressing so it soaks it up.
Flake the smoked mackerel into large pieces, discarding any skin.
Build the bowl with barley, arugula, beets, apple and mackerel and spoon over the rest of the dressing with the dill.

name: Smoky Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Finely dice the red onion and soften it in a dry skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes, stirring so it colours without burning.
Add the drained black beans and smoked paprika and cook for 5 minutes, crushing about a third of the beans with the back of a spoon so the mix holds together.
Splash in 3 tablespoons of water and simmer for 2 minutes until glossy, then season with salt.
Warm the corn tortillas one at a time in a second dry pan over high heat, 20 seconds per side, until flexible and lightly blistered.
Slice the avocado and chop the cilantro.
Fill each tortilla with the beans, top with avocado and cilantro and finish with a squeeze of lime.

name: Smoky Butter Bean Shakshuka
instructions: Soften the diced onion in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, smoked paprika, and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the strained tomatoes and butter beans and simmer for 5 minutes.
Make two wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are runny.
Crumble over the feta and serve straight from the pan.

name: Smoky Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chilli
instructions: Soften the diced onion in a large pot over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic, smoked paprika, chili powder, and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cubed sweet potato, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the sweet potato is nearly tender.
Stir in the black beans and simmer uncovered for 8 minutes until thick.
Season to taste and serve.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Finely dice the onion and carrot and mince the garlic.
Heat a splash of oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and ground beef, breaking it up as it browns, for 6-7 minutes.
Stir in the strained tomatoes and simmer uncovered over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rich and thickened.
About 10 minutes before serving, cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water for 10-11 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Season the bolognese sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Toss the spaghetti with the bolognese sauce and top with torn basil to serve.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving half a cup of pasta water.
Whisk the eggs with the grated parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
Cut the bacon into small pieces and fry with the crushed garlic until crisp.
Take the pan off the heat and add the drained spaghetti.
Pour in the egg mixture, tossing quickly so it turns silky, not scrambled.
Loosen with pasta water and serve with extra parmesan and pepper.

name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
instructions: Mix the ground beef with the panko, egg, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Roll the mixture into 4 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in a skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes, turning often.
Pour in the marinara, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti.
Finish with grated parmesan and torn basil.

name: Speedy Sausage Pasta
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 10 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of its casing and break into small pieces in a hot skillet with the olive oil, cooking for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and minced garlic and cook for 5 minutes, mashing the tomatoes slightly, until saucy.
Toss the pasta with the sausage and tomato sauce, adding a splash of pasta water if needed.
Plate and top with grated Parmesan.
Scatter with torn basil before serving.

name: Spiced Cauliflower Rice Bowl
instructions: Boil the basmati rice in salted water for 10 minutes, then drain and keep covered.
Cut the cauliflower into small florets and slice the red onion.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over high heat and fry the cauliflower undisturbed for 4 minutes so it chars on one side.
Add the onion, cumin and turmeric and cook for 3 minutes, stirring, until the spices coat everything.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and 3 tablespoons of water and cook for 3 more minutes until the cauliflower is tender.
Fold through the rice and the chopped parsley and season generously with salt.

name: Spiced Tomato Instant Noodles
instructions: Cook the minced garlic in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the chili powder and diced tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes until tender.
Stir well to break up the noodles.
Top with sliced green onions before serving.

name: Spiced Tomato Instant Noodles
instructions: Cook the minced garlic in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the chili powder and diced tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and cook for 4 minutes until tender.
Stir well to break up the noodles.
Top with sliced green onions before serving.
