name: Spicy Cajun Eggs & Beans
instructions: Dice the onion and bell pepper and mince the garlic.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute the onion and pepper for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic and Cajun seasoning and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and drained butter beans, then simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thickened.
Make two small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover the skillet and cook for 5 minutes until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still soft.
Sprinkle with chopped cilantro before serving straight from the skillet.

name: Spicy Mango Chicken Burgers
instructions: Butterfly the chicken breast to make a thin cutlet and rub with smoked paprika and a pinch of salt.
Dice the mango into small cubes and thinly slice the red onion.
Pan-fry the chicken in a little oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Toss the diced mango with the hot sauce to make a quick salsa.
Toast the burger bun cut-side down in the same pan for 1 minute.
Spread the mayonnaise on the bun base and layer with lettuce and the chicken.
Top with the mango salsa and sliced red onion, then close the burger.

name: Spicy Peanut Sweet Potato Soup
instructions: Sauté the diced onion in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the grated ginger and cayenne and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the peeled and cubed sweet potato, the crushed tomatoes and the broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes until the sweet potato falls apart when pressed.
Whisk in the peanut butter until the soup turns silky, then add the shredded kale and cook for 3 minutes.
Season with salt and a squeeze of extra heat if you like it fiery.

name: Spicy Prawn Spaghetti
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Warm the olive oil with the sliced garlic and red pepper flakes over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they burst.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2 minutes per side until pink.
Toss in the spaghetti with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley.

name: Spicy Sausage Tomato Spaghetti
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water for 1 minute less than the package says, reserving 0.5 cup of the pasta water before draining.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of its casing into a hot skillet and brown for 5 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon.
Mince the garlic and add it with the red pepper flakes to the skillet, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the strained tomatoes and simmer for 6 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the drained spaghetti and a splash of the reserved pasta water, tossing to coat.
Tear in most of the basil and toss through.
Grate the parmesan over the top and scatter with the remaining basil to serve.

name: Spicy Tofu Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Press the tofu dry and crumble it into rough pea sized pieces with your hands.
Fry it in a skillet with the sesame oil over high heat for 8 minutes, stirring only occasionally so it browns.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the soy sauce and sriracha and toss for 2 minutes until the tofu is glazed and sticky.
Separate the romaine into whole cup shaped leaves and grate the carrot.
Spoon the tofu into the leaves and top with carrot and sliced spring onion.

name: Spinach & Feta Quesadillas
instructions: Wilt the spinach in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes, then squeeze out every drop of liquid and chop it.
Mix the spinach with the crumbled feta, grated mozzarella, sliced spring onion and the lemon zest.
Spread the filling over one tortilla and cover with the second.
Brush the pan with the olive oil and cook the quesadilla over medium heat for 3 minutes until golden underneath.
Flip carefully with a plate and cook for 3 more minutes until the cheese has melted through.
Rest for 1 minute, then cut into six wedges.

name: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Shells
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Boil the pasta shells in salted water for 8 minutes so they are still firm, then drain and cool under running water.
Wilt the spinach in a dry pan for 2 minutes, squeeze out every drop of liquid and chop it finely.
Mix the spinach with the ricotta, half the parmesan, salt and black pepper.
Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the sliced garlic and oregano for 6 minutes, then spread the sauce in a small baking dish.
Fill each shell with the ricotta mix, nestle them into the sauce and scatter the remaining parmesan on top.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and browned at the edges.

name: Steak & Peppercorn Sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with a little oil, and roast on a tray for 30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Season the steak generously on both sides with black pepper and a pinch of salt, pressing the pepper into the meat.
Heat a heavy skillet over high heat until smoking, add the butter, and sear the steak for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Remove the steak to rest on a plate; mince the garlic and add it to the same skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds.
Pour in the beef broth, scraping up the browned bits, then stir in the heavy cream and simmer for 3 minutes until thickened.
Slice the rested steak against the grain and plate with the roasted potato wedges.
Spoon the peppercorn sauce generously over the steak and serve immediately.

name: Steak & Rice Bowls
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice, then simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until fluffy; keep warm.
Slice the steak into thin strips against the grain and mince the garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over high heat and sear the steak strips for 2 minutes until browned; set aside.
Slice the bell pepper and red onion, then stir-fry in the same skillet for 4 minutes until softened.
Return the steak to the skillet with the garlic and soy sauce, tossing for 1 minute to coat.
Spoon the rice into a bowl and top with the steak and pepper mixture.
Scatter sliced green onions over the top before serving.

name: Steak Burrito Bowls
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain and stir in chopped cilantro and lime juice.
Rub the steak with the taco seasoning.
Sear the steak in a very hot skillet for 3 minutes per side, then rest for 5 minutes.
Warm the black beans in the same pan.
Slice the steak against the grain.
Build the bowl with rice, beans, and steak, then top with salsa and sliced avocado.

name: Steak Fajita Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until tender.
Slice the steak into thin strips and toss with the taco seasoning.
Slice the bell pepper and onion into strips.
Heat a skillet over high heat and sear the seasoned steak for 3 minutes until browned; remove and set aside.
Add the peppers and onion to the same skillet and stir-fry for 5 minutes until charred at the edges.
Return the steak to the skillet, squeeze over the lime juice, and toss everything for 1 minute.
Serve over the rice and finish with chopped cilantro.

name: Steak Pie
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cut the steak into 1-inch cubes and dice the carrot and onion.
Melt the butter in an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat and brown the steak cubes for 4 minutes.
Add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute, then pour in the broth and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened into a gravy.
Transfer the filling to a small pie dish and top with a sheet of puff pastry, tucking the edges over the rim.
Brush the pastry with beaten egg and cut a small slit in the top to vent steam.
Bake for 25 minutes until the pastry is puffed and deep golden brown.

name: Steak with Chimichurri Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Halve the baby potatoes, toss them with half the olive oil and salt and roast for 30 minutes until crisp.
Take the steak out of the fridge and let it come to room temperature, then season it heavily with salt.
Sear it in a dry cast iron skillet over the highest heat for 3 minutes per side for medium rare, then rest it for 6 minutes.
Chop the parsley and garlic finely and mix with the vinegar, chili flakes and the rest of the oil to make the chimichurri.
Toss the hot potatoes in half the chimichurri, slice the steak against the grain and spoon the rest over with the arugula alongside.

name: Sticky BBQ Chicken Drumsticks
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Cut the potato into wedges, toss with olive oil, and spread on a sheet pan.
Rub the drumsticks with smoked paprika, minced garlic, and salt and add to the pan.
Roast everything for 30 minutes, turning once.
Mix the BBQ sauce and honey and brush over the drumsticks.
Roast for 10 more minutes until sticky and cooked through.
Warm the corn and serve alongside.

name: Sticky BBQ Chicken Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Cut the chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and mince the garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Add the garlic and frozen corn and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the BBQ sauce and a splash of water, tossing to coat the chicken, and simmer for 3 minutes until glossy and sticky.
Spoon the rice into a bowl and top with the sticky BBQ chicken.
Garnish with sliced green onions before serving.

name: Sticky Char Siu Pork Rice
instructions: Cut the pork into thick strips and toss them with the hoisin sauce, honey and minced garlic.
Simmer the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Sear the pork in a hot skillet for 3 minutes per side, letting the marinade caramelise without burning.
Add 3 tablespoons of water to the pan and simmer for 4 minutes until the sauce reduces to a sticky glaze.
Steam the halved bok choy in a covered pan with a splash of water for 3 minutes.
Slice the pork, pile it over the rice with the bok choy and finish with sesame seeds and spring onion.

name: Sticky Hoisin Tofu Noodles
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in just boiled water for 6 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Press the tofu dry and tear it into rough bite sized pieces so the sauce has something to cling to.
Fry the tofu in a hot wok with a little oil for 7 minutes, turning every couple of minutes until browned all over.
Add the sliced pepper, the halved bok choy and the minced garlic and stir fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in the hoisin sauce with 2 tablespoons of water and toss for 1 minute until everything is glossy.
Add the noodles, toss to combine and finish with the sesame seeds.

name: Sticky Hot Honey Chicken Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Dice the chicken thighs and sear in a hot pan for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the honey, hot sauce, and soy sauce and bubble until sticky, about 2 minutes.
Steam the broccoli for 4 minutes until just tender.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the broccoli and a scatter of sesame seeds.

name: Sticky Peri Peri Halloumi Bowls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cube the sweet potato, toss with olive oil and smoked paprika, and roast for 22 minutes until tender.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Mix the hot sauce and honey together to make the peri peri glaze.
Slice the halloumi and pan-fry in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Toss the halloumi in the peri peri glaze while still hot in the pan for 1 minute until sticky.
Build the bowl with rice and roasted sweet potato, then top with the glazed halloumi and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Sticky Teriyaki Chicken Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until tender.
Cut the chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and mince the garlic.
Steam or blanch the broccoli florets for 3 minutes until bright green and just tender; drain.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then pour in the teriyaki sauce and simmer for 3 minutes until sticky.
Spoon the rice into a bowl, top with the broccoli and teriyaki chicken.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

name: Sweet & Sour Chicken
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-size chunks and toss in the flour to coat lightly.
Heat a skillet with a little oil over medium-high heat and fry the chicken for 6 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through; set aside.
Dice the bell pepper and stir-fry in the same skillet for 3 minutes.
Whisk together the ketchup, soy sauce, and honey with 2 tablespoons of water to make the sweet and sour sauce.
Return the chicken to the skillet with the corn, pour in the sauce, and simmer for 3 minutes until glossy and thickened.
Serve the sweet and sour chicken over the rice.

name: Sweet & Sour Pork
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Cut the pork into 1 inch cubes and toss them with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Fry the pork in a hot skillet with a little oil for 7 minutes, turning, until crisp and cooked through, then set it aside.
Stir fry the chunks of pepper in the same pan over high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the ketchup, rice vinegar, soy sauce, pineapple with 3 tablespoons of its juice, and simmer for 3 minutes until glossy.
Return the pork and toss for 1 minute so the sauce clings, then serve over the rice.

name: Sweet Chilli Beef Bowls
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Shred the carrot and red cabbage finely and squeeze over half the lime juice to make a quick slaw.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground beef for 6 minutes, breaking it apart with a spoon.
Stir in the hot sauce and honey and simmer for 3 minutes until the beef is glossy and coated.
Squeeze the remaining lime juice over the beef and stir through.
Spoon the rice into a bowl and top with the sweet chilli beef.
Finish with the carrot and cabbage slaw on the side.

name: Sweet Chilli Chicken Rice Boxes
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until tender.
Cut the chicken breast into bite-size strips and mince the garlic; julienne the carrot.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic and carrot and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Stir in the hot sauce and honey, tossing to coat, and simmer for 2 minutes until sticky.
Spoon the rice into a bowl or lunch box and top with the sweet chilli chicken.
Scatter sliced green onions over the top before serving.

name: Sweet Chilli Prawn Noodles
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes according to the package, then drain and set aside.
Peel and devein the shrimp and slice the bell pepper and carrot into thin strips.
Mince the garlic.
Heat a splash of oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the shrimp for 2 minutes until pink; remove and set aside.
Add the bell pepper, carrot, and garlic to the wok and stir-fry for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return the shrimp to the wok with the noodles, sweet chilli sauce, and soy sauce, tossing for 2 minutes until well coated.

name: Sweet Chilli Salmon Bowls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Pat the salmon dry and place on a lined baking sheet, then brush generously with the sweet chilli sauce.
Roast the salmon for 12 minutes until it flakes easily and the glaze is sticky.
Julienne the cucumber and carrot into thin strips.
Fluff the rice and divide between bowls with the cucumber and carrot.
Top with the sweet chilli salmon, a squeeze of lime, and chopped cilantro.

name: Sweet Potato & Kale Buddha Bowl
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet.
Cut the sweet potato into 1 inch cubes, toss with half the olive oil and the smoked paprika and roast for 25 minutes, turning once.
Add the drained chickpeas to the sheet for the final 10 minutes so they dry out and crisp.
Simmer the quinoa in a saucepan with double its volume of water for 14 minutes, then rest covered for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Massage the torn kale with the remaining olive oil and a pinch of salt for 1 minute until it softens and darkens.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of water into a pourable dressing.
Build the bowl with quinoa, kale, sweet potato and chickpeas and spoon the dressing over.

name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Burritos
instructions: Cut the sweet potato into half inch cubes and boil in salted water for 10 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Cook the rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Fry the diced onion in a skillet with a splash of oil over medium heat for 5 minutes, then add the cumin.
Add the sweet potato and the drained black beans and cook for 5 minutes, crushing a few beans so it binds.
Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds per side in a dry pan so they roll without cracking.
Fill each with rice, the bean mix, sliced avocado and a squeeze of lime, then fold in the sides and roll tightly.

name: Sweet Potato Burrito Bowls
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Cube the sweet potato, toss with olive oil and cumin, and roast for 22 minutes.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Warm the black beans in a small pan.
Build the bowl with rice, beans, and roasted sweet potato.
Top with salsa, sliced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Sweet Potato Curry
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Soften the diced onion in a large pan for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, and curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cubed sweet potato and coconut milk and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook for 5 more minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Fold in the spinach until wilted and serve over the rice.

name: Sweet Soy Cod with Spicy Broccoli
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Mince the garlic and whisk together with the soy sauce and honey in a small bowl.
Pat the cod dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat and sear the cod for 4 minutes per side until it flakes easily; remove and set aside.
Steam the broccoli florets for 5 minutes until bright green and tender, then toss with the red pepper flakes.
Pour the sweet soy mixture into the skillet and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly thickened, then spoon over the cod.
Serve the glazed cod over the rice with the spicy broccoli alongside.

name: Tandoori Chicken Skewers
instructions: Mix half the yogurt with the garam masala, grated ginger, minced garlic, half the lemon juice and plenty of salt.
Cut the chicken into large chunks and coat them in the marinade, then leave for 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 450°F and line a tray.
Thread the chicken and thick wedges of red onion onto skewers and bake for 18 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Cook the basmati rice according to the packet directions, or bake it covered with double its volume of boiling water for 20 minutes.
Serve the skewers on the rice with the rest of the yogurt and the remaining lemon.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Dice the chicken thighs and sear them in a hot pan for 6 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets and sliced carrot and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Pour in the teriyaki sauce and simmer until sticky, about 2 minutes.
Serve the chicken and vegetables over the rice.
Scatter over the sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

name: Teriyaki Prawn Rice
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Peel and devein the shrimp and slice the carrot into thin rounds.
Heat a splash of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and stir-fry the shrimp and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets and stir-fry for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Pour in the teriyaki sauce and toss for 2 minutes until the shrimp and vegetables are glazed.
Fluff the rice, top with the teriyaki shrimp and vegetables, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Teriyaki Salmon Salad
instructions: Pat the salmon dry and sear in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side.
Pour the teriyaki sauce into the skillet and simmer for 2 minutes, spooning it over the salmon until glazed.
Chop the romaine lettuce and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Dice the cucumber and slice the avocado.
Toss the lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumber together in a large bowl.
Flake the teriyaki salmon over the salad, add the avocado, and drizzle with any remaining glaze from the pan.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

name: Teriyaki Tofu Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat.
Press the tofu dry and cut it into thick slabs about half an inch across.
Sear the tofu in a hot non-stick skillet for 4 minutes per side until golden and firm.
Boil the edamame in salted water for 3 minutes and drain, and cut the carrot into fine matchsticks.
Pour the teriyaki sauce over the tofu in the pan and let it bubble for 1 minute until sticky.
Serve the tofu on the rice with the edamame and carrot alongside, finished with sesame seeds and spring onion.

name: Thai Basil Chicken Rice
instructions: Cook the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Heat a wok until smoking and fry the ground chicken for 6 minutes, pressing it flat so it browns properly.
Add the sliced garlic and chili flakes and stir fry for 1 minute.
Add the trimmed green beans and cook for 3 minutes so they stay squeaky.
Pour in the soy sauce and oyster sauce with 2 tablespoons of water and toss for 1 minute.
Take the wok off the heat, fold in the Thai basil until it wilts and serve over the rice.

name: Thai Coconut Chickpea Curry
instructions: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain.
Fry the curry paste, minced garlic, and grated ginger in a pan for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the chickpeas and simmer for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Fold in the spinach until wilted.
Squeeze in the lime juice and serve over the rice.

name: Thai Coconut Shrimp Curry
instructions: Simmer the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes and rest off the heat.
Cook the curry paste in a wide pan over medium heat for 1 minute until it darkens and smells fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the sliced pepper and trimmed green beans and simmer for 6 minutes until just tender.
Stir in the shrimp and cook for 3 minutes only, until they turn pink and curl.
Finish with lime juice and serve over the rice.

name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Cut the chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and slice the bell pepper; grate the ginger.
Heat a splash of oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in the ginger and 2 teaspoons of green curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and bell pepper, then simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Squeeze in the lime juice and stir through.
Serve the curry over the rice, topped with chopped cilantro.

name: Thai Green Curry with Tofu
instructions: Simmer the jasmine rice in a covered saucepan with double its volume of water for 12 minutes, then leave it to steam off the heat.
Fry the cubed tofu in a hot skillet with a little oil for 6 minutes, turning until golden on most sides, then lift it out.
Cook the curry paste in the same pan over medium heat for 1 minute until it smells fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5 minutes to thicken slightly.
Add the trimmed green beans and sliced pepper and simmer for 6 minutes until just tender.
Return the tofu to the pan for 2 minutes, finish with a squeeze of lime and serve over the rice.

name: Thai Green Prawn Curry
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Slice the bell pepper into thin strips.
Heat a splash of oil in a saucepan over medium heat and fry the green curry paste for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and fish sauce, then bring to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and shrimp and simmer for 5 minutes until the shrimp turn pink and are cooked through.
Fluff the rice and ladle the curry over the top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Thai Red Chicken Curry
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in 5 fl oz of water, covered, for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Cut the chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and slice the bell pepper.
Heat a splash of oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in the red curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and bell pepper, then simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Squeeze in the lime juice and stir through.
Serve the curry over the rice, topped with chopped cilantro.

name: Thai Red Prawn Curry
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice and simmer in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Slice the bell pepper into thin strips.
Heat a splash of oil in a saucepan over medium heat and fry the red curry paste for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and fish sauce, then bring to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the bell pepper and shrimp and simmer for 5 minutes until the shrimp turn pink and are cooked through.
Fluff the rice and ladle the curry over the top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Three Bean Chilli
instructions: Dice the onion and cook in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, chili powder, and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and all three beans.
Add a splash of water, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover and simmer for 5 more minutes to thicken.
Season to taste before serving.

name: Three Bean Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Halve the peppers, remove the seeds, and roast cut-side up for 10 minutes.
Soften the diced red onion in a pan for 3 minutes.
Add all three beans, the diced tomatoes, and cumin and simmer for 8 minutes.
Spoon the bean mixture into the pepper halves and top with shredded cheddar.
Bake for 12 minutes until the peppers are tender and the cheese is melted.

name: Tomato Bacon Pesto Spaghetti
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Cut the bacon into small pieces and fry until crisp.
Add the minced garlic and halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until the tomatoes soften.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the pesto.
Toss in the spaghetti with a splash of pasta water.
Serve topped with grated parmesan.

name: Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Warm the olive oil with the sliced garlic over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Pour in the strained tomatoes and red pepper flakes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Toss in the spaghetti with a splash of pasta water.
Tear in the basil and toss once more before serving.

name: Traybake Beany Quesadillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Mash the black beans with the cumin and finely diced bell pepper.
Spread the bean mixture over one tortilla and scatter with shredded cheddar.
Top with the second tortilla and place on a baking tray.
Bake for 12 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Slice into wedges and serve with the salsa.

name: Tuna & White Bean Salad
instructions: Slice the red onion as thinly as you can and let it sit in the lemon juice with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes.
Warm the drained beans in a small pot with a splash of water for 3 minutes so they take on the dressing better.
Whisk the olive oil into the lemon and onion mixture with plenty of black pepper.
Drain the tuna well and flake it into large chunks rather than shredding it.
Toss the warm beans, tuna and halved tomatoes through the dressing.
Fold in the arugula and parsley right at the end so the leaves stay perky.

name: Tuna Crunch Salad Bowl
instructions: Drain the canned tuna well and flake it into a bowl.
Stir the mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon juice into the tuna until combined.
Chop the romaine lettuce and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Dice the cucumber.
Toast the tortilla chips in a dry skillet over medium heat for 1 minute, tossing, to crisp them up.
Toss the lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumber together in a large bowl.
Top the salad with the tuna mixture and crumble the toasted tortilla chips over the top for crunch just before serving.

name: Tuna Lemon Rocket Pasta
instructions: Cook the penne in boiling salted water for 11 minutes, then drain, reserving a splash of pasta water.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the minced garlic for 1 minute.
Flake in the tuna and warm through for 2 minutes.
Toss the penne through the tuna, loosening with the reserved pasta water.
Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon juice and arugula until just wilted.
Season and serve immediately.

name: Tuna Melt Jacket Potato
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Prick the potato all over with a fork, rub it with a little oil and salt and bake for 55 minutes until the skin is crisp and it gives when squeezed.
Cover the peas with boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain them.
Drain the tuna well and mix it with the mayonnaise, peas, sliced spring onion and a squeeze of lemon.
Split the hot potato down the middle, fluff the inside with a fork and pile the tuna mix in.
Scatter the grated cheddar over and return to the oven for 6 minutes until it melts and bubbles.

name: Tuna Melt Pasta Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 9 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Dice the onion and saute in a splash of oil over medium heat for 4 minutes until softened.
Drain the tuna and flake it, then stir into the pan with the onion.
Add the drained pasta, frozen peas, and white sauce to the pan and stir to combine, warming through for 2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and scatter the shredded cheddar evenly over the top.
Bake for 15 minutes until the cheese is melted, golden, and bubbling at the edges.

name: Tuna Pasta Protein Pots
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne for 9 minutes until al dente, then drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
Drain the tuna well and flake it into a large bowl.
Halve the cherry tomatoes and finely dice the red onion.
Stir the mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon juice into the tuna until well combined.
Add the cooled pasta, cherry tomatoes, and red onion to the bowl and toss everything together.
Spoon into pots, sprinkle with chopped parsley, and chill briefly before serving.

name: Tuscan White Bean Soup
instructions: Sauté the diced onion and carrot in a pot with a splash of oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until soft and sweet.
Add the sliced garlic and chopped rosemary and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and two thirds of the beans, bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend about half the pot until smooth, then return it so the soup is creamy but still has whole beans in it.
Add the remaining beans and the shredded kale and simmer for 5 minutes.
Toast the sourdough in a dry skillet for 2 minutes per side, tear it into the bowl and ladle the soup over.

name: Vegetable Cottage Pie
instructions: Peel and chop the potatoes, then boil in salted water for 15 minutes until fork-tender.
Meanwhile, dice the carrot and onion and simmer with the lentils in the vegetable broth for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk until smooth.
Spoon the lentil and vegetable filling into an oven-safe dish.
Spread the mashed potato over the top and rough up the surface with a fork.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until golden on top.

name: Vegetable Curry
instructions: Dice the sweet potato and onion, and mince the garlic.
Sauté the onion and garlic in a pot over medium heat for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the ground cumin and cook for 30 seconds, then add the sweet potato and chickpeas.
Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a simmer, and cook for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Meanwhile, cook the basmati rice in salted boiling water for 15 minutes.
Season the curry with salt to taste and serve over the rice.

name: Vegetable Lasagne
instructions: Dice the zucchini and mushrooms and sauté in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until softened.
Stir the sautéed vegetables into the marinara sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Spread a thin layer of the white sauce in the base of an oven-safe dish and top with a lasagne sheet.
Layer the vegetable marinara, more white sauce, and another lasagne sheet, repeating until the ingredients are used, finishing with white sauce.
Top with shredded mozzarella and grated Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for 10 more minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Cook the egg noodles in boiling water for 4 minutes according to the package, then drain and set aside.
Slice the carrot into thin matchsticks and chop the broccoli into small florets.
Mince the garlic and ginger.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the broccoli, carrot, and bell pepper for 5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the soy sauce and toss in the cooked noodles, stir-frying for 2 minutes until everything is coated and heated through.

name: Veggie Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the basmati rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, then drain and cool slightly.
Dice the carrot finely and beat the eggs in a small bowl.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok over high heat and scramble the eggs for 1 minute, then push to one side.
Add the carrot and peas and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry for 3 minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Toss through the scrambled egg and top with sliced green onions.

name: Veggie Katsu Curry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet.
Cut the sweet potato lengthways into half inch slabs, then coat each one in flour, beaten egg and panko in that order.
Bake the slabs for 22 minutes, turning once, until the crust is crisp and deep gold.
Meanwhile sauté the diced onion and carrot in a saucepan with a splash of oil over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder, cook for 1 minute, then add 1 cup of water and simmer for 12 minutes until thick.
Blend the sauce smooth and boil the rice in salted water for 10 minutes.
Slice the katsu into strips and serve over the rice with the sauce poured alongside.

name: Veggie Pad Thai
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in just boiled water for 6 minutes, then drain and rinse in cold water so they stop cooking.
Press the tofu dry, cut it into small cubes and fry in a hot wok with a little oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Stir the tamarind paste and soy sauce together with 2 tablespoons of water and 1 teaspoon of sugar.
Push the tofu aside, add the drained noodles and pour the sauce over, tossing constantly for 2 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts and most of the spring onion and toss for 1 more minute so they stay crunchy.
Serve with the crushed peanuts, the rest of the spring onion and a wedge of lime.

name: Warm Lentil & Red Cabbage Bowl
instructions: Simmer the rinsed lentils in a pot of salted water for 22 minutes until tender but not collapsing, then drain.
Shred the red cabbage finely and slice the onion.
Sauté the onion and cabbage in a large skillet with half the olive oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until softened and glossy.
Add the vinegar and cook for 2 minutes so the cabbage turns bright purple again.
Whisk the mustard with the remaining oil and toss the warm lentils through it.
Fold the cabbage and the diced apple into the lentils and finish with parsley, salt and black pepper.

name: Zinger Burger Bowl
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into strips and toss with the hot sauce.
Dip the chicken in beaten egg, then coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry the chicken in a little oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Chop the romaine lettuce, halve the cherry tomatoes, and thinly slice the red onion.
Whisk the mayonnaise with a splash of water and a dash of hot sauce to make a drizzle.
Build the bowl with lettuce, tomatoes, and red onion.
Slice the crispy chicken and place on top, then drizzle with the sauce.
